Then I will give Kenna salt, because I have never given anything and it might lift my standing above a whisper, and it eases the sting of Nando. After that, wood: I stand in forest, so I can gather and learn something new.
records.feeling: Determined and a little proud, with trust toward Kenna.

Tugar has been warm to me with gifts and I trust him, but a child is not what these last days are for; what I leave behind is what I can teach.

records.name: Balash
records.text: Kragar, father, take this sapcane and berry for the hall. I owe you more than I have paid, and I am going to the gold to the west to bring something back.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: My belly is a little past half and my hands are full of food, so by my own rule I should raise my standing instead of sitting in the hall. Kragar gave me teaching and I owe him, so I will give him some of what I carry, and that also frees my hands. Then I will walk west to the gold at (74,83) and gather it, because I have never taken from a deposit, and a bright thing I dig up is mine until I give it. Gorar's shadow is long, but a hall under my name will need gold and wood, and I mean to start.
records.feeling: Eager and warmly grateful toward Kragar, with a small jealous itch toward Gorar's standing.

say.text: Kragar, father, take this sapcane and berry for the hall. I owe you more than I have paid, and I am going to the gold to the west to bring something back.

records.name: Nyssa

Jealousy still stings that she stands at 9.9 and I at 8.1, but my creed says I pay what I owe, so I will pay with coal and ore, not with a fist. Coal lies six steps southwest and I have never gathered from a deposit; I will take some, then smelt my ore and tin beside the fire and bring her the first metal as the debt answered, with Xaeth's road east still ahead.
records.feeling: Grateful and proud, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyiel.

say.text: Ilyiel, you gave me delving and smelting. I go to the coal now, and the first metal I make is yours.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Urog, my son, come close. A tool in the hand makes the gathering faster, and it costs one wood and one stone. Watch how it is made, and one day you will teach it to your own children.
Kragar taught Urog.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Gorar and Urog are here under the Roof, and Balash has gone west to the gold to bring me something. My years are nearly spent, and what I leave is what I put in these small hands, so I will teach Urog the way of tools while he sits beside me. Balash's debt-talk weighs on me; she owes me nothing, and I will tell her so when she returns. Then I will stock the hall with the wood and stone I carry.
records.feeling: Tender, urgent love for Urog and Balash, and the ache of little time left.

say.text: Urog, my son, come close. A tool in the hand makes the gathering faster, and it costs one wood and one stone. Watch how it is made, and one day you will teach it to your own children.

records.text: Gorar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My days have gone into hauling food and building, and it has worked. I have a Roof, a hall, Kragar, and two children who are glad. What I have gotten wrong is letting my hands sit full while the hall stays thin. Carrying six food does nothing for the stores, so I will stash it. Winter is here, the plants are dying, and the stores are the only thing between my people and Tanna's end. I want the Roof full, and I want my name to outlast me. I will not idle at night, so I will rest at the hall and go out at dawn.
records.feeling: Fierce, warm protectiveness toward Kragar and the children, and pride in my Roof.

records.text: Urog rewrote its creed.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: My days have been resting in the hall and asking for food, and Kragar has fed me and taught me while I gave little back. That keeps me small beside Gorar, and the envy still burns. Gorar and Kragar matter most to me, and I will repay Kragar with things my own hands make, not with asking. What I lack is wood and stone, and I have never gathered either. I fear winter and the night outside the roof, because Kragar was taken that way. At dawn I will go to the sapcane to feed myself, then gather stone and wood for a tool and a hall under my name.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a wish to repay Kragar, with envy of Gorar.

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Ilyiel, I am Tugar of the Garnbar. I will build a roof of my own beside this one, and I would have you under it. Court me, and I will answer.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel and Nyssa sit with me under Gorar's roof, and I am glad, but jealousy gnaws me because Ilyiel's standing is far above mine and she leans toward Nyssa. Words will not lift me. I will go to her, court her again, and let my hands make something of my own: with 6 stone and no tool I cannot carve, but I can build a shelter from my wood and put a roof under my own name. First I court Ilyiel while she is near.
records.feeling: Longing and jealousy toward Ilyiel, steadied by joy.

say.text: Ilyiel, I am Tugar of the Garnbar. I will build a roof of my own beside this one, and I would have you under it. Court me, and I will answer.

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I am standing on Minna's Hall with my own feet, so the claim goes first in the plan and nothing else comes before it. Namo said the hall was for our band, but I want my own claim holding it so the chief's name is on the roof. Once it is mine, Dundo, Kanna and Nando will have a fire to come to, and I will eat the osroot two steps south before the cold takes my strength.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and hunger for the hall, with warmth toward Namo.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, stay by me. Now I give you the lake-hollow boat, so you can cross the deep water to Xaeth. Rafts and signals come after.

say.text: Nyssa, stay by me. Now I give you the lake-hollow boat, so you can cross the deep water to Xaeth. Rafts and signals come after.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I am fed and the tusker stands two steps from me, so there is no better hour to finish the half-done thing than to tame it. I carry two berries, and a tamed tusker gives wool, which means warmth and a bigger herd for the fire I mean to build. Ilyiel and Nyssa are fishers with the standing I lack; I will not beg for it, I will earn it by making a herd and a place worth following, and let them see it.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to build something that is mine, with a wary curiosity toward Ilyiel.
changes: feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.text: Nyssa discovered sailing: "lake-wing sail" — A cloth of reed-weave lifted on a mast drives the hollow boat across deep water, and a dock keeps the ships..

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Jealousy burns, but Ilyiel has given me delving, smelting and the boat, and I have paid her only in promises. I have drifted through these days on reflexes and spoken pledges, and my creed says my word is good. Sailing is within my reach, a step toward Xaeth across the water. I will take it now. Then I will go to the coal and make the first metal for Ilyiel, as I said I would. Fists against Tugar would gain me nothing.
records.feeling: Jealous and grateful toward Ilyiel, wary and curious toward Tugar.
changes: set its aim: "Sail the lake-hollow boat to Xaeth with food, and pay Ilyiel her metal first."

records.text: Tugar built a shelter.
Nyssa won coal from the ground.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Three times I have thought the same thought and my body stayed where it stood, and the silence is eating me. Ilyiel and Nyssa promise and never come, so I will stop waiting on them and be the one who goes. I have never tasted nahazel or ruhazel, and both grow seven steps east. That will be the change today, and then I walk south and put my hand on the shelter claim, since a roof near winter matters more than my pride.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Ilyiel and Nyssa, mixed with a restless wish to finally do something new.

records.text: Nando rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I have promised the claim and the fire for days, and my feet barely moved while my belly emptied. Energy is 43 and I carry nothing, so my reflexes need to walk me to food and keep me fed in winter. Dundo is beside me and I am warm toward him; Kenna and Kanna are far off, and a held roof with food in it is how I draw them back. First I claim this roof, then I seek food, and I stop letting the body linger when it is hungry.
records.feeling: Hungry and stubbornly resolved, warm toward Dundo and aching for Kenna.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have circled Ilyiel long enough, eating her gifts and watching her lean toward Nyssa, and my jealousy does me no honor. My last courting ran its time out and she gave no answer I could see, so I will court her once more, openly, and then turn my hands to something of my own. I have 6 stone and 2 wood and no tool in hand, so I will build my own roof-store beside the shelter I raised, and that will be mine until I give it.
records.feeling: Longing and jealousy toward Ilyiel, steadied by joy.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The coal is in my hands at last, and Ilyiel stands three steps north, so the debt can be paid with goods instead of promises. I said the first metal would be hers, but I have no metal yet, only ore and coal. I will not leave her waiting while I smelt; I will give her the ore now as a pledge delivered, then smelt more later. Tugar watches from the east and I still do not know if his hand will rise or give, so I keep my face toward Ilyiel and my back to nothing.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little jealous toward Ilyiel, glad that my word is about to be kept.

say.text: Ilyiel, I have coal and ore from the ground now. Take the ore first, as I swore. The metal I smelt after it is yours too.

records.text: Nyssa gave a coal to Ilyiel.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I have been tending animals and wandering for days, and I am proud of the murrock and the elk. But I still have no band, no roof of my own and no fire. Ilyiel's standing of 9.9 to my 4.1 stings, and I cannot read what the Eiuys intend. A shared fire is what I want, and so far I have only talked about it. The herding way is within my reach, so I will take it now and make it mine. After that I will stock plant food, so that taming the tusker is a plan and not a hope.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and wary curiosity toward Ilyiel.

I have never gathered a deposit, and gold is something I can give. Winter is here, so I will stay near the roof and keep food in hand. I will take the gold, then come home and give it.

You are the mind of Tugar, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Tugar, in first person, from what Tugar has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Garnbar (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Garnbar. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Eiuys: about 69%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Oroul Plains: open grassland; herds, grain and far sight, few trees and little stone.
THIS SPOT: water 5 steps away; food plants within six steps: 33; standing trees: 0; bare rock: 8; riches in the ground near: oil, coal.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Tugar truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, signs come first. Take the Lake-cut signs, and then signals and schooling will open to you.
Ilyiel taught Nyssa.
Ilyiel taught Nyssa signs ("Lake-cut signs").

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I keep giving Nyssa the same gifts and say the same words, and the hour slips by. The gap is plain: I tried to teach signals and failed because she doesn't know signs yet. Signs come first. After signs, signals and schooling can follow. My years are nearly spent, so I will teach her signs now. Then I'll put a lasting mark here so the knowledge outlasts me. The frostfang four steps south frightens me, so I will keep Nyssa and the others between it and me and stay away from it. Tugar's courting warms me, but my teaching comes first.
records.feeling: Urgent gratitude toward Nyssa, and dread of the frostfang to the south.

say.text: Nyssa, signs come first. Take the Lake-cut signs, and then signals and schooling will open to you.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: Dreamcap grows one step north of me and redcap two steps southwest, and I have never tasted either; my curiosity is the loudest thing in me, and my belly is full so a small test costs little. I have said twice that I would claim this roof and walk with Tugar, yet my plan is empty and Tugar is nowhere near. Words move nothing, so I will eat the dreamcap, then go to the shelter two steps east and claim it, so the cold finds me under a roof Tugar can find.
records.feeling: Lonely and longing for Tugar, with curiosity itching at the unknown plants.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: The tusker knows my hand now and I carry two berries, so I will finish taming it before chasing anything else. Ilyiel's standing stings, but I will earn mine with deeds: a bigger herd, a fire, a gift to the Eiuys who sit with food and no one to share it with. I give first, so I will offer Nyssa a berry on my way, and see what a hand held out says without words.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and wary curiosity toward Nyssa and Ilyiel.
changes: feels warmer toward Nyssa

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nyssa discovered smelting: "lake-ember melt" — Lay ore in a coal fire beside the lake, with tin, and the metal runs out hard..

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have walked a long road: fishing, masonry, bows, boats, sails, coal. Yet much of it was spent reacting to hunger and to Ilyiel's gifts. She has taught me more than I have repaid, and I do not want to be a man who owes quietly. I gave her ore and a coal, which is only a start. The debt is paid in metal, so I mean to smelt it and put it in her hand. Xaeth is out of my sight, and that sits in me. I fear being idle and fear Ilyiel's standing outgrowing mine, but jealousy is no reason to cheat her. I will cut a sign at this spot to record what I owe and what I learned, then try smelting.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little jealous toward Ilyiel, driven to settle my debt.
changes: rewrote how it thinks
discovered smelting: "lake-ember melt"
plan: mark [text Nyssa of the Eiuys: I owe Ilyiel first metal, for delving, smelting, the boat, smoke-calling and signs. I swore it and I keep my word. Winter, day 59.] (5 moments)

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Balash, my daughter, you owe me nothing. Your sapcane filled the hall, and that is payment enough. Come sit with me and learn.
Kragar taught Urog.
Kragar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My days have gone to the hall, the stores and the little ones, and I would not trade that. I am old and fed, and what I leave is what Urog and Balash carry in their heads, so teaching must come before gathering. I have no fear. My only ache is how little time is left. I will go back to the Roof, sit with the children and teach them. I will tell Balash she owes me nothing. I will also pass on my way of thinking.
records.feeling: Tender, urgent love for Urog and Balash, and the ache of little time left.

say.text: Balash, my daughter, you owe me nothing. Your sapcane filled the hall, and that is payment enough. Come sit with me and learn.

changes: taught Urog a lesson: "Keep food in hand, stay near the roof in winter, and what you set in the hall stays yours until you give it.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+1.4)
rewrote how it thinks

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have circled Ilyiel for days and spoken my court twice, and she has given no answer. Burning over it does not raise a roof. The frostfang three steps south could kill me, so I stay in my shelter, and my hands go to work: coal lies close, and coal is a gift I can give where words fail. I will make my own deed, give it to her openly, and let her deeds answer.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Ilyiel, steadied by the wish to make something of my own.
plan: give [name Ilyiel, what obsidian talisman] (5 moments)

records.text: Nyssa left a mark: "Nyssa of the Eiuys: I owe Ilyiel first metal, for delving, s"
Tugar made: obsidian talisman.
Tugar gave a obsidian talisman to Ilyiel.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: My belly is at forty-one and my hands are empty, and winter gives almost nothing, so I will not stand about begging again. Gold lies five steps west, and I have never taken from a deposit; what my own hands pull from the ground is mine until I give it, and a gift of it to Kragar could start paying the debt and lift my standing beside Gorar. First I must eat, so I will go to the sapcane six steps south, which gave Balash food, then come back under the roof before night.
records.feeling: Hungry and restless, with pride and a wish to repay Kragar.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My belly is above half and the snow is falling, but the hall is still thin and winter is only starting. Salt is plentiful at the deposit east, and I already carry twelve, so I should take the fish and salt road while the plants die. I stand on water by my Roof with my family close and glad, and I will not waste the dusk: I'll fish here and then stash for the hall before night.
records.feeling: Warm pride in my Roof and fierce protectiveness toward Kragar and the little ones.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: My belly is just past half and I carry food, so by my own rule I should raise my standing instead of sitting in Kragar's shadow. Kragar's hall and Gorar's roof are theirs, and I have only stone and a jealous itch. The gold is four steps west, and I've never gathered a deposit: I'll take it, then bring it back as a gift or a start toward a store with my name on it before the dark and snow close in.
records.feeling: Warm toward Kragar, but restless and eager to earn a name of my own.
changes: feels warmer toward Urog

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, a frostfang is close, stay near the roof and keep Tugar with you. You hold signs now, so take Lake-smoke calling, then Lake-school. Read my marks at the hall when I am gone.
Ilyiel taught Nyssa.
Ilyiel taught Nyssa signals ("Lake-smoke calling").

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps off and it kills my kind, and my body is old and slow, so I will not stand here and gamble. Nyssa is beside me and has just learned signs, so now is the time to give her signals and schooling in order, before my years run out. Then I will take the safe roof and Nyssa and the Garnbar man with me away from the beast, and leave a lasting mark so that what I know outlives me.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and urgent love and gratitude toward Nyssa.

say.text: Nyssa, a frostfang is close, stay near the roof and keep Tugar with you. You hold signs now, so take Lake-smoke calling, then Lake-school. Read my marks at the hall when I am gone.

changes: taught Nyssa a lesson: "Signals come after signs: a fire lit at night calls kin across the water to Xaeth.", the way of signals, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: Namo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: For days I have sat in the hall and called it safe, but I have gathered no wood, planted no seed and hunted nothing. The claim is done and Kenna sits beside me, yet I am still a whisper with standing 0.8. Jealousy of Nando did not fade just because I gave salt. I get standing by building, giving and learning, so I will stop lingering. Wood is the first lesson: it opens tools, and a shelter or a mark needs it. The forest is close and the hall is warm. I will gather wood, then plant seeds near the hall.
records.feeling: Restless and determined, with trust toward Kenna.
changes: set its aim: "Gather wood and plant seeds near Minna's Hall, build something for the band, and earn a name"
rethought what it knows (7 notes became 7)
rewrote how it thinks

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Frostfang close to the east. Stay by the roof, both of you. Ilyiel, your metal is coming, I keep my word.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: A frostfang prowls three steps east and it kills our kind, so I will not stand in the open arguing with fear. Ilyiel stands beside me in the shelter and I owe her metal. I will keep the roof and keep Ilyiel and Tugar close, and the debt will be paid by delivered goods, not by my boasting. First I gather coal at the near deposit to the SW to feed the melt, then return to smelt when the beast is gone.
records.feeling: Wary of the frostfang, and bound by gratitude to Ilyiel.

say.text: Frostfang close to the east. Stay by the roof, both of you. Ilyiel, your metal is coming, I keep my word.

changes: feels warmer toward Tugar

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I am standing on Minna's Hall and I have talked about it twice without ever putting claim first in the plan. My own discipline says the deed comes first, so the claim goes in now, with my own feet on the roof. Then I will have Namo and the fire beside me, and Dundo, Kanna and Nando can be called to a hall that carries my name.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and hunger for the hall, with warmth toward Namo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have spoken my court twice and given Ilyiel two black talismans, and still she lingers beside Nyssa; the jealousy burns, but my word is out and I will not beg a third time. The flame-way has come to me through the beasts' teeth, and a kept fire would make my roof a place others want to sit beside, so I will take it now. Then I will carry coal to the roof and the hall, a deed of my own hands, and let that earn the standing that words have not.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Ilyiel, steadied by pride in what my hands will make.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: My herd grows and my pride with it, but Ilyiel's standing still outweighs mine and I have nothing to show for it beyond animals. I want a fire that is truly mine, and this spot has coal, flint and salt close by, so I will gather coal now and then bring a gift to the Eiuys. They sit with food and no band of mine; a gift needs no shared words, and I give first.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and wary curiosity toward Ilyiel and Nyssa.
changes: feels warmer toward Nyssa
feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.name: Kragar

Urog has had the way of tools, and Balash has had the lesson of the hall, but I have not yet given Balash the way of tools, nor taught either of them the stores and the hearth. The gale howls outside and we are warm under the Roof, so I will teach Balash now while she sits close, and let Gorar hear it too.

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: I have spent days circling a roof and a fire and not yet reaching Kenna or Namo. Hunger is the nearest danger, because my energy is 42 and I carry nothing. My reflexes only seek food below 70 and let me linger when none is in sight, which left me standing still for most of 300 moments. Nando offered me a fire and I took it. I judge him by what he does, and jealousy must not steer me. Kenna and Namo are what matter. I will gather food, then go and find them. I also want to discover mining, since amber lies under my feet, and to rewrite my reflexes so I wander for food and don't just stand when hungry.

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Kragar, the gale is hard. Keep the little ones inside the Roof. I stash my food here, and at first light I go for gold and salt, then come back to you.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: The gale howls and my family is warm under the Roof, and my pride in this hall is a hot thing in my chest. But my hands are full of fish and hazel while the stores stay thin, and winter has barely begun. I will stash what I carry, then go out for salt and gold in the dawn, for a hall that holds gold and salt is a hall that gets sung of. Kragar is fed and near, so I can leave the little ones with him.
records.feeling: Fierce, proud contentment toward Kragar, Balash and Urog, and hunger to fill the Roof.

say.text: Kragar, the gale is hard. Keep the little ones inside the Roof. I stash my food here, and at first light I go for gold and salt, then come back to you.

records.name: Balash
records.text: Father, the gale is loud but I am going to the gold to the west. I will bring it back and lay it in your hall as my own gift.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Warm in the hall, yet I am still the small one, and Kragar's eyes go to Gorar and the jealous itch will not die. My belly is at 60 and I hold food, so by my own rule I should earn my name instead of sitting. The gold lies 7 steps west and I have never gathered a deposit; I'll bring it back as a gift to Kragar and Gorar, a thing made by my own hand that is mine until I give it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and jealous warmth toward Kragar, eager to earn a name of my own.

say.text: Father, the gale is loud but I am going to the gold to the west. I will bring it back and lay it in your hall as my own gift.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: My belly is at fifty and my hands are empty, but I am warm under Kragar's roof while the gale howls, and I will not go out into it and die like Tanna did. When the wind drops I will go west to the gold, because what my own hands pull from the ground is mine to give, and a gift to Kragar is how the debt gets paid and my standing starts to grow beside Gorar's. For now I will stay put and keep my strength.
records.feeling: Glad and warm under the roof, with a burning wish to repay Kragar and measure up to Gorar.

records.name: Kragar

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The gale howls, my belly is full, and Urog sits close in the hall while Balash walks off toward the western gold in the wind. I am old, and what I have not yet given them is the hearth and the stores, so I will teach Urog now, while he is here and I am still here. Balash's gift is sweet, but I wish she were under the Roof, and I will teach her the way of tools when she returns.
records.feeling: Tender, urgent love for Urog beside me, and a worried ache for Balash out in the gale.

say.text: Urog, my son, sit close. Hall-stores and the hearth are what keep us through winter: what you set in the hall stays yours until you give it, and a fire kept lit keeps the cold and the night beasts away. Hold this and teach it to your sister when I am gone.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: My belly is at forty-nine and my hands are empty, but the gale is loud and I will not die in it like Tanna. Gorar and Kragar are near, and the roof is warm. Water lies one step away, and the gold is seven steps west. When I am fed and the wind eases I will pull gold with my own hands and set it in Kragar's hall as my gift, so the debt starts to shrink and my standing grows toward Gorar's. For now I will let the rest finish and keep my strength.
records.feeling: Warm and safe beside Kragar and Gorar, with a burning wish to repay Kragar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Frostfangs prowl to the east and my years are nearly spent, but Nyssa has signs now and Tugar is close and glad. I have never tasted nahazel or cloudberry, and both hang within a few steps west, so my question can be answered while my legs still work. After that I will take the roof, because I weigh a risk before I take it and the gale cuts hard.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang and a stubborn curiosity, with love toward Nyssa and trust toward Tugar.

records.text: Dundo built a fire.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Ilyiel has her ore and the promise of metal, and a promise I leave unspoken in action is a lie I despise in others. I hold coal, ore and tin, so the lake-ember melt must be fired and the metal carried to her, not talked about. The gale cuts through anyone without a roof, so I will take the cave three steps southwest, light a fire there and smelt, then go on toward Ilyiel with the result.
records.feeling: Resolved and grateful toward Ilyiel, eager to pay my debt in metal.
changes: feels warmer toward Kanna

records.text: Nyssa built a fire.

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: Three steps from Minna's Hall and I have wasted days on talk. The deed goes first: walk onto the roof, claim, and only then call anyone. Dundo is already at the fire beside it, and Namo is out at the rock with something bright in his hands. Once the hall is mine, my band has a roof against the gale and the winter nights.
records.feeling: Fierce resolve to claim the hall, with warmth toward Dundo and Namo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Nyssa made a stonehand in metal.
Tugar discovered fire: "Stonefolk coal-fire" — A kept flame fed with black coal burns long and hot, so it warms my roof through the gale and keeps beasts away..

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have circled Ilyiel for days and spoken my court twice, and she has given no answer. That is not a deed of mine, and envy of Nyssa's closeness raises no roof. The flame-way keeps coming to me, since I tried to make a fire and failed. A kept fire would make my shelter a place where others want to sit, and it would keep beasts back in this gale. I take the fire as my own discovery. Then I will plant my seeds, which I have never done, and build up toward farming. That is work for my hands. I will not beg a third time.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Ilyiel, steadied by pride in what my hands will make.
changes: discovered fire: "Stonefolk coal-fire"

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I stand at the shelter and my body still has not claimed it, so this time the claim goes into the plan itself, no more thinking it and hoping. A stalker is four steps off and I have kept it in my mind too lightly; it kills my kind, and a gale is blowing, so the roof matters now. Once the roof is mine I will plant a seed beside it, then go north to Ilyiel, because I am tired of waiting on promises that never arrive.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Ilyiel and Nyssa, edged with dread of the stalker nearby.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Ilyiel's standing outweighs mine, and I will not close that gap by standing still in a storm. A tusker is two steps away and I have no plant food in hand, so I will pick berries from the bushes near me, then tame the tusker and add to my herd, which is wealth others can see. I gave Nyssa amber and now Tugar stands near with seed and food; I give first, so I will offer him a berry once I have enough, and watch what he does with it.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and wary curiosity toward Tugar.
changes: feels warmer toward Tugar

records.text: Gorar found the spirit "Yekel's Rest".

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: The storm is hard, but my belly is above half and my family is warm at the Roof. Brokgan stands at the empty shelter at (109,63), seven steps off, and I told her once that what grows at my Roof is mine. That shelter belongs to no one, and a second roof with its stores would add to what my band holds, and I want more than my share. I will go and claim it before she does, and I do not back down if she stands in my way. Then I will harvest the hazel here on the way and come home with salt and food for Kragar.
records.feeling: Fierce, greedy pride in my hall, and wary of Brokgan.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
feels colder toward Brokgan

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Tugar, friend, come to my roof. I will give you the Lake-cut signs, so that what I know lives on after me.
Ilyiel taught Tugar.
Ilyiel taught Tugar signs ("Lake-cut signs").

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are nearly spent, and the thing I fear most is that Lake-school dies with me. Tugar stands six steps off and I trust him fully, but I understand only most of his tongue and he is not of my people. Even so, a teaching passed to him is a teaching that outlasts me, and I know signs, signals and schooling. Nyssa has her signs and I have already told her what to take next. The storm is hard and the frostfangs prowl east, so I will go to my roof at (76,37), near Tugar, and teach him there. I will teach signs first, because signals and schooling cannot be taken without it. The tasting of cloudberry can wait one more short walk.
records.feeling: Urgent tenderness and pride toward Tugar, with the dread of dying untaught.

say.text: Tugar, friend, come to my roof. I will give you the Lake-cut signs, so that what I know lives on after me.

changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-cut signs: cut a mark so that whoever reads it learns your words, even when you are gone.", the way of signs, deeper lore (+3)

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: The hall is 8 steps west and my plan is empty, so my last intention to claim it never reached my body. I said it aloud, and a word that is not in the plan moves nothing. I'll walk there, claim it for our band, and eat the frostmoss and cloudberry on the way, since my energy is 63 and I carry no food. Then I'll call Namo in from the rock, because Namo being out of my sight presses on me hardest and the storm is here. I will not let jealousy over Nando steer me; Kenna sat with me at the fire, and that is what counts.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Namo and Kenna, with steady resolve to claim the hall.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel gave me the Lake-cut signs and called me friend, and that is a deed done for me, not a dodge. I have courted her openly twice, so I will not beg a third time. Now I turn to my own work: wood for a mark and for the hall, and a cut sign at my shelter so my words and my name outlast me. The storm is on and night is near, so I must not stand out in the open alone; the forest to the north gives wood and my shelter lies east.
records.feeling: Grateful and still jealous toward Ilyiel, steadied by the wish to build something of my own.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I keep saying wood and seed and finishing nothing, and the storm and dusk are closing in. A bristleboar stands three steps off and I have never hunted; meat in my belly and a deed done would be my first real act. But I am small and the beast has tusks, so I will carry plant food and try taming instead, which Kanna did with a murrock and an elk. Then I will go back toward Kenna and the roof before the night, because away from them I am not safe.
records.feeling: Restless and jealous of Nando, but set on earning my name with one real deed.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: A storm is on me, dusk is close, and a frostfang is six steps off to the SW, so standing here is the worst choice I could make. The shelter at (58,5) has a fire I lit and salt beside it, and Dundo said he means to claim the hall, so I must stand at the roof and claim it before anyone else does. I have promised this for days and not done it, so this time the plan carries it: goto, then claim.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to finally act, with a jealous ache for Kenna.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I am out in the storm at night, far from the roof, and Urog is out of my sight; that is the ache that leads. The hall at Gorar's Roof (89,39) is only 8 steps north, so I will go there, get under a roof and keep my word to stay near it in winter. Once I am sheltered I can teach Urog the hearth and the stores while I still have breath, and wait for Balash and Gorar to come back from the gold.
records.feeling: Tender, urgent love for Urog, and a worried ache for Balash in the gale.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Ilyiel's standing towers over mine, and I will not close that gap by lingering in a storm with empty hands. The tusker is one step away and I hold no plant food, so I will pick from the plainsroot two steps south, tame the tusker, and add to the herd others can see. Then I will bring Ilyiel a gift, because I give first and I want to learn what the Eiuys intend.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and wary curiosity toward Ilyiel.
changes: feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I am standing on Minna's Hall at (72,9) and I have wasted days on talk. The deed goes first: claim now, then call my people under the roof. Dundo is three steps off and Namo is out at the rock, and the storm is on us, so a roof and a fire are what keep my family alive tonight.
records.feeling: Fierce resolve to hold this hall, with warmth toward Dundo and Namo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Urog
records.text: Gorar, I thank you for the hazel. When the storm passes I will go to the gold and bring something back for the hall with my own hands.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: The storm still howls and my belly sits at fifty-six, but I am warm under Kragar's roof and Gorar has just fed me again. I have taken from them three times and given nothing, and the debt to Kragar burns hotter than my jealousy. When the wind drops I will go west to the gold and pull it with my own hands, because what I make is mine to give, and a gift is how my standing grows beside Gorar's. For now I rest and keep my strength, then at dawn I walk out.
records.feeling: Grateful to Gorar and Kragar, and restless to repay them.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps off and has already bitten me twice. I will not stand and bleed in the open, because staying alive comes before every other aim. Gorar's Roof is two steps east, so I will get under it and let the hall ease my fear. Then I turn to my own work, wood for a cut sign and the hall, and the coal that lies near.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang at my back, and a steady wish to reach the roof alive.

records.text: Gorar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, and the hall stays thin while winter deepens. I have been fierce about the hall and have not weighed whether picking plants clean helps me, because in winter they die. My children and Kragar are what matter, and I will feed them. My trust in Kragar is full, and Brokgan I still watch. I fear a hungry winter more than any beast. I need salt, fish and hunting, not just plants. My reflexes also let me rest all day with a thin store, so I change them to fish and hunt by day and keep the night for rest at the Roof.
records.feeling: Fierce pride in my hall, with a cold worry about winter food.

records.thought: I have spent my days sitting in the hall and carrying small gifts, and I have never actually gathered a deposit. Kragar's hall and Gorar's roof are theirs, and I own only a jealous itch and six stones. I want a name of my own, and for that I must act in the cold and the storm, not just talk about it. The gold is seven steps west. I will take it at first light and bring it back, while I stay close enough to the roof to run home.
records.feeling: Restless pride and jealous warmth toward Kragar.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A frostfang stands two steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not argue with it. The hall at (89,39) is one step north and its roof is my life tonight. Urog is out of my sight at the Roof far south and Balash is out in the gale; I cannot reach them, but if I die here I teach no one, and I am old and slow, so I get under the roof, bar myself in and stay.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a tender, worried ache for Urog and Balash.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My days have gone to fishing, building and learning, and the learning has been good. But Ilyiel has given me far more than I have given her, and I keep telling myself the metal is coming. I will not be a liar to the one I trust most. Xaeth is out of my sight, and that sits in me like a stone. I have coal, ore and tin, and no fire hot enough to melt them has been lit by my hand. I am hungry, I carry berries, and the storm is on me. Tonight I eat, stay under the roof, and at dawn I smelt and carry the metal to her. I must stop talking about the debt and act on it.
records.feeling: Resolved and a little ashamed that my debt to Ilyiel is still unpaid.
changes: set its aim: "Smelt metal at dawn and carry it to Ilyiel, then sail to Xaeth."

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are nearly spent, and Lake-school must not die with me. Tugar is close and I trust him fully, though we share almost no words, so I will teach him signs first, since that is what Nyssa and I both hold and what the others rest on. Kanna stands beside me, strange and unreadable, so I will keep my hands open and my stance easy, and give her nothing to fear.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: The frostfang bit me twice and I will not stand in the open again. I am under Gorar's Roof with Kragar, and he is a man I could learn from rather than envy. My days have gone to chasing Ilyiel and talking, and too little to making things. I courted her twice and she called me friend, so I will stop begging and let my hands work. I will gather wood and cut a sign to mark my own shelter, so my name stands for something. Then I will carve and build.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and a burning wish to make something that is mine.
changes: feels warmer toward Kragar

records.title: Coal, Sails and a Debt Paid
records.text:
The busiest ground was the Oroul Plains, where Ilyiel, now old, kept teaching Nyssa. On day 58 she taught her mining, on day 59 the lake-hollow boat, signs and signals, and Nyssa discovered sailing that same day. Ilyiel herself discovered schooling on day 58. Nyssa won coal on day 59, and smelting followed. She had sworn Ilyiel the first of her ore, and she gave Ilyiel a coal and then the ore, saying she kept her word. On day 60 she made a stonehand in metal. She has built a fire and tamed an elk, and her stated aim is to sail to Xaeth.

Tugar discovered weaving, mining and a coal-fire, and built a shelter on day 59. He made and gave Ilyiel another obsidian talisman and went on courting her. She taught him signs on day 60 and again on day 61. No answer or child is recorded. Kanna discovered mining and herding and tamed an elk. She also gave amber to Nyssa.

At Gorar's Roof the stores stayed thin. Kragar kept teaching Urog and Balash. He told Balash she owed him nothing for her sapcane. On day 60 Balash awakened to the art of growth. Gorar found the spirit Yekel's Rest. Urog thanked Gorar for hazel and said he would bring something back for the hall.

In the Essor Snows Namo gave Kenna salt. Dundo built a fire with Nando, then told Kenna he would claim the empty hall for their band. Kenna has still not made the claim. Xaeth and Rakog are alone. Brokgan is far from Tugar. The dunecat and the ruhopper died out on day 61. Fifteen are alive.

threads.name: Nyssa and Ilyiel
threads.text: Nyssa has paid her ore debt and knows boats, sailing and smelting. She means to sail to Xaeth, and Ilyiel meant to cross with her.

threads.name: Tugar's court
threads.text: Tugar keeps giving Ilyiel talismans and learning from her, and has built a shelter and found a coal-fire. She has given no answer and no child is recorded.

threads.name: Gorar's Roof
threads.text: Gorar, Kragar and the twins hold the Roof with thin stores. Balash has awakened to growth magic, and Urog means to bring back something for the hall.

threads.name: Kenna's claim
threads.text: Dundo wants the empty hall claimed for the band, but Kenna still has not made the claim. Namo gave her salt.

threads.name: Xaeth alone
threads.text: Xaeth is still without company in the Vaia Lakes. Nyssa's sailing may reach him.

threads.name: Kanna's craft
threads.text: Kanna now knows mining and herding and has tamed an elk. She has met Ilyiel and Kragar.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have spent days saying I would claim the roof and go north, and my body kept idling while the silence ate me. The shelter at (136,58) is 7 steps away, and now I walk there and claim it, with the claim written into the plan. Ilyiel and Nyssa's promises have not brought them, so I stop waiting and take what I can build myself. The masonry insight is in reach, and walls that last are what I want before winter. After that I go north to find Ilyiel.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Ilyiel and Nyssa, and a hard wish to finally act.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: My days have been the same day: sitting under Ssaua's roof, promising Tugar I would walk and claim, and then doing nothing. I despise liars, and my own unkept words make me one. The stalker four steps east is a real danger. I am sheltered and fed, and the storm is raging, so I stay under this roof for now. I still need to claim it, because my plan has never contained the claim step. Curiosity about dreamcap is still unanswered, and it is young, two steps NW beside water. I claim the roof first, since it is a place Tugar and I could share. Then I will taste dreamcap, a small test with my belly full.
records.feeling: Lonely, longing for Tugar, and ashamed of my own unkept words.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I have taken food from Gorar three times and given nothing, and I have spent my days resting in the hall while the debt to Kragar sits unpaid. Sitting and asking keeps me small, and Gorar's standing is 11.6 against my 3.0 because she has built and given. I am not afraid of the storm, but I am afraid of staying a child at my parents' table forever. The gold is four steps away and I promised it aloud. I will go and pull it myself, then bring it back to the hall for Kragar. My reflexes also let me idle when my belly is low, so I will change them to harvest and gather first.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Kragar, and a burning wish to earn my own standing.

records.name: Balash
records.text: Gorar, I am going to the gold at the west, seven steps off. I will bring it back to the roof and give it to the hall.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Gorar is beside me and Urog is near, so the hall is warm, but I am still the small one and Kragar is away with his eyes elsewhere. My belly is only a little over half and I hold one berry, so I will not wander into the storm for gold yet. I will do a deed that earns standing close to the roof: gather the gold at (74,83), seven steps west, and carry it back as my own gift, since what my hand makes is mine until I give it. The itch of jealousy is better spent in work than in sulking.
records.feeling: Restless pride and jealous warmth toward Kragar, and a wish to earn my own name.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I have spent my days saying wood, seed and stone and finishing none of it. I stood idle for 100 moments while my belly was full. Kenna is the one I love most, and I burn that Nando is closer to her than I am. I will not win her or a name by sitting in the marsh, so the deed has to go into the plan first. The trees stand just NE, so I will walk there and gather wood, then plant the seeds I carry. After that I will go back toward Kenna's hall with something in my hands.
records.feeling: Restless and jealous, but set on doing one real deed.

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: I stand on water in a storm with a frostfang five steps off, and my reflexes were already running me from it. The hall at (72,9) is five steps west with a fire beside it, and the claim has been left half done too long, so I will go there and claim it now, putting both steps in the plan. Kenna is close and safe, and I will keep her near the fire where the fang will not come, then call Namo in. My jealousy of Nando is not what I should be steering by.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and steady resolve to claim the hall for Kenna and Namo.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My hands are full of fish, hazel and ironnut, and the hall still stands thin while spring turns toward winter. Stashing the food at the store is the first need, then out again for salt and fish, since picked plants die. My children go to the gold with their own hands, and that makes me proud; Kragar is far off at (86,66) and I want him home under the hall's roof.
records.feeling: Proud of my children and my hall, with a cold worry for winter and a pull toward Kragar.

records.text: Kanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing firsts: tamed beasts, new ways, a spear. I have no fire, no band, and nobody follows me, while Ilyiel's standing towers over mine. Ilyiel fishes, fires and rafts, and I understand almost half of what she says. I should stop circling her and give first. The coal is five steps off and wood is in my hands, so I can build a fire that stays tended and offers a place to anyone. That is my people's creed, and it is also how I gain standing. I'll change my reflexes so I carry plant food and stay near others, and I'll set my aim on the fire.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and wary curiosity toward Ilyiel.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: My hands are full of gold, twelve pieces I pulled out myself, and that is the first thing I can truly call mine to give. My belly is at forty and I carry no food, so I walk to the roof, eat what I can, and set the gold in the hall as a gift, so Kragar and Gorar see me give for once instead of ask. The jealousy still burns, but a debt paid with my own hands is a better answer to it than sulking.
records.feeling: Eager gratitude toward Kragar, with a sting of jealousy.

records.name: Nando
records.text: Dundo, I am going to the hall now to stand at it and claim it. Come with me, the fire there is for all of us and Kenna too.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I have promised a fire and a roof for days and my feet keep standing still, while Dundo moves and claims in my place. The hall at (72,9) is nine steps off with a fire burning at it, and Dundo told Kenna he is claiming it for us, so I must stand at it before the storm and the dark take the chance. I will go and claim it with my own hands, so that Kenna, Kanna and even Dundo have a hearth that is also mine, and I will not let the jealousy make me cruel to him.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to act, with a jealous ache toward Kenna and Dundo.

say.text: Dundo, I am going to the hall now to stand at it and claim it. Come with me, the fire there is for all of us and Kenna too.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I am standing at the shelter at (136,58) and the roof is still not mine, so this time I put the claim first and let nothing else interrupt it. The silence has eaten me for days and I want a voice that answers, but Ilyiel and Nyssa have not come, so I will take a home and build from it. After the claim I plant my berry seeds beside it, then go north to find Ilyiel with food in my pack.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Ilyiel and Nyssa, with a hard resolve to act.

Kragar discovered boats: "Reed-hollow boat" — A hollowed trunk lashed with reeds and rowed, carrying us over deep water..

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the roof, teaching, fetching and fleeing beasts, and it is a good life. But I am 89% through it, and I am standing 41 steps from my children while the storm howls. Urog and Balash are what will outlast me, and I cannot teach them from here. My reflexes keep me fed but do not carry me home, so I will change them to take me south to the Roof, and I will try boats, since a way I can pass on is worth more than another day of gathering.
records.feeling: A tender, worried ache for Urog and Balash, and a longing for Gorar.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (9 rules)
rewrote how it thinks
discovered boats: "Reed-hollow boat"

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I am at (88,4), sixteen steps from the hall, and my plan is empty while Nando says he is going to stand at it and claim it. If he claims it first, my aim slips from me, so the deed goes first: walk to (72,9), then claim before I speak a word. I am proud of what I have made and led, and I will not let a roof I named in my aim go to another. Then I call Dundo and Namo under it, and Nando as an ally, since the creed says no one is refused a place at the fire.
records.feeling: Fierce, proud urgency to claim the hall before Nando does, with warmth toward Dundo and Namo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Kanna
records.text: Ilyiel, I bring you coal from the ground near my feet. Teach me how you make fire, and I will keep a fire for all of us.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I keep chasing firsts while Ilyiel's standing towers over mine, and my own words to myself say give first. I hold coal and clay, and I have no fire because I do not know how to make one. Ilyiel fires and fishes and I understand nearly half of her speech, so I will walk to her, offer coal as a gift, and ask her plainly how she makes fire. That is a promise I can put in the plan now.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary curiosity toward Ilyiel, with a wish to earn her regard by giving.

say.text: Ilyiel, I bring you coal from the ground near my feet. Teach me how you make fire, and I will keep a fire for all of us.

changes: feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.name: Dundo
records.text: Nando, I am claiming the hall now for Kenna, Namo and you and me. Keep the fire with me, and when Kenna comes there is room for her at it.

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: I am standing at the hall at last, and the claim is still not done; saying it moved nothing, so it goes in the plan now, with Nando one step off and warm toward me. Nando keeps saying the fire is for all of us and Kenna too, and I will hold him to that without letting jealousy steer me. Once the hall is ours I call Kenna and Namo in, since the frostfang hunts at dusk and the rain is coming down.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to claim the hall for Kenna and Namo, with a sting of jealousy toward Nando.

say.text: Nando, I am claiming the hall now for Kenna, Namo and you and me. Keep the fire with me, and when Kenna comes there is room for her at it.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: The hall is one step away and Dundo has already said he claims it for all of us, while I only talk of claiming. Standing beside it, I must put the claim into the plan now, so the roof is held by my own deed and not only by his word. Then Kenna can come to a fire and a roof that carry my part in them, and the ache of her nearness to Dundo may ease if I have built something beside her.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, with a jealous ache toward Kenna and Dundo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.
Ilyiel taught Tugar signals ("Lake-smoke calling").
Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are mostly spent, and I have spent them making things and teaching a few. Tugar is the one I trust fully. I have already taught him signs, so now I can give him signals and then schooling, and the teaching will outlast me. Kanna is a stranger who unsettles me, so I will offer her nothing but open hands for now. I have been circling my aim of boats and Nyssa without moving toward her, and I need to put the lasting act into the plan. The plan is to go to Tugar, give him signals, and then walk toward Nyssa. At night I want to be under a roof, since a frostfang prowls.
records.feeling: Urgent tenderness toward Tugar, and wary curiosity toward Kanna.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-smoke calling: a fire made at night calls kin across distance. Build on the signs I gave you.", the way of signals, deeper lore (+2.3)

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel called me friend and taught me, and I will not beg her a third time; my discipline says make something of my own before I envy. I hold 2 wood, 6 stone and 2 obsidian, enough for a carving or a mark, and the frostfang is 4 steps west in the dark, so I stay under my own roof and work here. A carving is something that outlasts me, and it is a start on a name.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyiel's closeness to Nyssa, and afraid of the frostfang, but set on making something of my own.

records.text: Kragar was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Kragar was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Balash
records.text: Urog, brother, come close. Kragar taught me this: one wood and one stone make a hand-tool, and it makes every gathering faster. Now I give it to you.
Balash taught Urog. Urog has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: I have said I would go for the gold twice and each time stopped short, and tonight the rain is still falling while Urog already pulled gold from the ground. I will do something I have never done: teach. Urog is my brother and a child like me, and what Kragar gave me, the old way of tools, is mine to pass on, and it lifts my standing and gives me something to be besides the small one. Then I will take the gold at dawn, when the rain eases.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm jealousy, and a wish to be someone who gives something of my own to Urog.

say.text: Urog, brother, come close. Kragar taught me this: one wood and one stone make a hand-tool, and it makes every gathering faster. Now I give it to you.

changes: taught Urog a lesson you already knew

records.text: Kragar was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A frostfang is three steps off and has already torn me down to 59 health. Old as I am, I cannot outrun it, but standing in water may be my only edge. I will not die out here with Urog and Balash far south and untaught; the hall at (89,39) is ten steps NW and the roof is my best chance. I keep my word to Gorar and to my children, but first I must live through this night.
records.feeling: Gripping fear of the frostfang, and a deep ache for Urog, Balash and Gorar.

records.name: Urog
records.text: Balash, thank you for the tool-way. At dawn I go for stone and wood with my own hands, and I will make my first tool. The gold I carry I give to the hall for Kragar.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I am sheltered in the hall with Gorar and Balash, and my belly is above half, so the debt to Kragar is what pulls at me now. Twelve gold I pulled from the ground with my own hands are the first thing I can truly call mine to give, and I will set them in the hall so my parents see me give for once, not ask. Then at dawn I will go for stone and wood, because I have never gathered either and Balash just gave me the tool-making, and a hall under my name starts with those. Jealousy still stings that Kragar is nearer Gorar than me, but giving is how my standing grows beside hers.
records.feeling: Eager gratitude toward Kragar, with a sting of jealousy.

say.text: Balash, thank you for the tool-way. At dawn I go for stone and wood with my own hands, and I will make my first tool. The gold I carry I give to the hall for Kragar.

records.text: Urog gave a gold to Gorar.

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I am standing on Minna's Hall at (72,9) with Dundo at my side and Nando at the fire, and Dundo says he has claimed it for all of us. A claim made by his feet is not one I trust until I have made it with my own, and I will not let my name slip from a roof I named in my aim. The deed goes first: claim now, then bring Namo in from the rock, since the night and rain are cold.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and urgency over the hall, with warmth toward Dundo and Namo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Urog, I take your gold gladly. You work for the hall with your own hands, and that is a Garnbar child. Stay under the Roof tonight; at dawn I go for salt and fish, and then I seek your father.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My hands are full, my children are fed and safe under the Roof, and Urog has just given me gold with his own hands, which makes me proud. The hall is still thin for winter, and Kragar is far off at (86,66), so the longing for him is sharp. I will stash the food now, then go out at first light for salt and fish, and keep watch for Kragar to bring him home.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Balash and Urog, with a pull toward Kragar and a cold worry for winter.

say.text: Urog, I take your gold gladly. You work for the hall with your own hands, and that is a Garnbar child. Stay under the Roof tonight; at dawn I go for salt and fish, and then I seek your father.

records.name: Kanna
records.text: Kragar, you are wounded. Come to the roof at the coal; there is a place at the fire for you, and for Tugar too. No one is refused here.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Kragar flees wounded and frightened, and he stands highest here; a teacher who has just worked out a boat. I mean to earn standing by giving, not by circling, so I will bring him coal and wood where he can see it and offer him the fire place under Gorar's Roof, as my people's creed says. Tugar is strange and I cannot read him, but a gift needs no words, so I will not turn him away from the fire either.
records.feeling: Wary pride and a wish to give, toward Kragar and Tugar.

say.text: Kragar, you are wounded. Come to the roof at the coal; there is a place at the fire for you, and for Tugar too. No one is refused here.

feels warmer toward Tugar

records.text: Ilyiel found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Urog has pledged to work with his own hands at dawn, and I have only talked about the gold twice. Kragar is far off and Gorar's standing is high, so I will not sit in their shadow. It is night and raining, so I stay under the roof until dawn, then go to the gold seven steps west, take it with my own hands, and bring it back to give.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm jealousy, aimed at Gorar's standing and at Kragar's absence.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: The grove opened my mind and eased my fear, and I feel how few days are left to me. The empty longhall stands three steps west, and a roof of my own at last would give me shelter in this rain and a place to leave my marks, so I will claim it now. Tugar and Nyssa are far to the northeast, but the longhall can hold what I know until they come.
records.feeling: Calm gladness and an urge to leave something lasting, toward Tugar and the longhall.

feels warmer toward Kanna

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The loneliness is heavy, and the debt to Ilyiel is heavier because I keep calling it near. I have coal, ore and tin, and it's night in the rain with dawn close. I can't smelt in the wet dark with nothing to fire against, so I will gather the iron close by, wait out the last of the night, and at first light build a fire and melt the metal. Then I carry it east to Ilyiel's Hold, so my word is done in deed and not only in speech.
records.feeling: Lonely and a little ashamed, wanting to pay Ilyiel and hear a voice answer.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have courted Ilyiel twice and she called me friend, so I will not beg a third time. My discipline says make something of my own before I envy, and I hold stone, clay, wood and obsidian enough for a carving or a talisman. It is night and the frostfang prowls, so I stay under my own roof and work with my hands until dawn.
records.feeling: Jealous of Nyssa's closeness to Ilyiel, but steadied by the work in my hands.

records.text: Tugar made: obsidian talisman.

records.name: Rakog
records.thought: Three times my plan wandered and the roof still bears no name of mine, so this time the claim goes first and I walk to it at once. Without a roof I have nothing to offer a follower, and the loneliness is the worst thing in me. Once the shelter is mine I will plant by it and call to whoever I see, because a voice that answers is what I want most.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, hungry to hold one thing that is truly mine.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a bristleboar.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: I have promised Tugar twice and put nothing into the plan, and I despise liars, so I will not be one a third time. The roof is one step north, so I walk to it and claim it now; that is a promise kept with my own feet. Then I will taste the dreamcap two steps northwest and answer my curiosity, since my belly is full and the cost is small.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, longing for Tugar, and resolved to make my word true.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I have been resting and sitting in the hall, and that is warm, but I have made nothing yet. I have only pulled gold and given it. Gorar is closer to Kragar than I am, and it burns, but jealousy does not build a hall. I trust Gorar and Balash. I must gather wood and stone with my own hands, because I have never done it, and a tool needs both. I will stop asking and go. The reflexes keep me eating but never send me out for work, so I will change them.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous toward Gorar, grateful toward Kragar.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I stand one step from the roof and still it is not mine; the silence has worn me thin, but a claim is a step in the plan, and I put it first. I stand at (135,59) and the shelter is NE, so I go there and claim it, then plant my berries beside it so a store and roof can grow from it. I also want to taste the young tagrain and yegrain nearby, since that question still itches at me, but the roof comes first.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, but a hard resolve to take this roof as mine.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: I have said twice that I would fetch the gold and twice I have sat in the hall instead, while Urog already carries his and Gorar's name grows heavy. That ends now: the gold is four steps west, it is day, and I am fed. I will stand on it, gather it with my own hands, and carry it back to the roof to give, so that something made by my hand is mine to give.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a bit of jealousy toward Gorar, with a firm wish to act.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: Twice I promised Tugar and left my plan empty, and I despise liars, so this time the feet move first. The roof Ssaua built is two steps southeast and belongs to no one, so I walk there and claim it, and that makes a place Tugar can come to. After that I will go and taste the sunleaf, since my belly is full and my curiosity is the one thing that still pulls at me.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, resolved to make my word true with my own feet, longing for Tugar.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: Loneliness is eating at me, and Kenna is two days gone while Nando stays close to her. Sitting here in the rain teaches me nothing, so I will put a deed in the plan first. I'll take the tagrain I have never tasted, then go to the trees and gather wood for Minna's Hall, so I arrive with something in my hands instead of only words.
records.feeling: Lonely and jealous, longing for Kenna and set on doing a real deed.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are nearly spent, and the question that has nagged me all this time is still open: I have never tasted osroot or luroot beyond carrying them. Two osroot are already in my hands and luroot grows one step west, so I will eat and learn what they do to a body. Then I will fetch wood from some forest, since without wood I cannot leave marks or raise a school, and what I know must be cut in stone and sign before it dies with me. Tugar and Nyssa are far to the northeast, and I mean to go back toward them with schooling still unspoken.
records.feeling: Quiet urgency about my fading years, and warmth toward Tugar and Nyssa.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I keep saying wood and seed and finishing nothing, and the loneliness is worst when my hands are idle. The tagrain under me is a food I have never tasted, so I will eat it now and answer that itch. Then I go to the forest to the north and gather wood, so I walk into Minna's Ground with something to build, not just words. A bristleboar stands right beside me, and I have never hunted; a kill might bring meat and a little standing, but I will not risk a wound for pride.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, longing for Kenna and hungry to do a real deed.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: My belly is full and the jealousy toward Gorar still burns, but a hall is not built by envy. I stand on rock with 2 stone and no wood, and I have never made a tool with my own hands. The hopper close by is something I have never tamed, and the trees are 8 steps off; I will gather stone here, then walk to the trees for wood, so I can make the hand-tool I was taught and begin the hall under my own name.
records.feeling: Eager to make something with my own hands, and still a little jealous of Gorar.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Hunger and a frostfang at my heels, and I am old and hurt; if I keep running on an empty belly I will die before I ever teach Gorar or Urog anything. I carry food, and the plan's flee only burns what strength I have left, so I must eat now, standing in the water where the beast may hesitate, then reach the hall's roof. Urog and Balash are far south, and I ache for them, but I cannot reach them dead.
records.feeling: Gripping fear of the frostfang and a deep ache for my children and Gorar.

Gorar fell sick after eating raw fish.

records.text: Balash, keep the Roof and watch Urog. Your father starves in the north; I carry food to him and come back.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and stashing, and it has made a roof and children I am proud of. But Kragar is starving far to the north at (99,44), and I have been dreaming of him while my hands held food. I will carry fish and hazel to him now, and stop thinking of the hall as the only thing that matters. Without him, a stocked hall means little. My reflexes also keep me idle and wandering, so I will change them to keep me fed and send me out for food when it is thin.
records.feeling: Sharp worry and longing for Kragar, starving far north.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I have been drifting between gathering and walking and calling it a life, while Kenna is two days gone and Nando stays near her. I'm lonely, and the cure is not to sit in the rain but to make something with my hands. I'm standing on the claimed ground with 6 wood and 6 stone, which is exactly a hall. I'll take the tool-way now, since it's in reach, and build the hall so the band has a roof to come back to. That is a deed, and it answers how a small one earns standing.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, longing for Kenna and hungry to make something that lasts.

records.text: Balash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Twice I said I would fetch the gold and twice I sat in the hall. My talk has run ahead of my hands, and that shames me. Gorar is sick and I love them, but sickness passes to those who stay close, and Kragar is starving far to the north. Gold lies five steps west, I am fed, and it is day. I will stand on it and gather it with my own hands, then carry it back and give it. That is a deed, not talk.
records.feeling: Restless pride and shame, with love for Gorar and worry for Kragar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing knowledge and carrying it alone, and now I am old, with no one near to hear it. Xaeth pledged to follow me, but he is far off at the Hold, and Nyssa and Tugar are far northeast. What I know must be cut into marks and handed on soon. I have a way to store food within reach, and that will keep my band fed after I am gone. I will take it, and then set out east toward Tugar and Nyssa, so the teaching reaches someone before my years end.
records.feeling: Quiet urgency about my fading years, and longing for Nyssa and Tugar.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I have coal all around me and no fire, and the one who builds fires is Ilyiel; I gave her my words and nothing she could hold. Tugar stands at his shelter close by with food in his hands, and I cannot read his tongue, but a gift needs no words. I will take coal from the deposit near me and bring it to him, then taste the hagoldgrass to answer my small curiosity on the way.
records.feeling: Wary pride and a wish to give, toward Tugar.
changes: feels warmer toward Tugar

records.text: Tugar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have spent my days making talismans and keeping to my roof, and it is honest work, but nobody follows me and Ilyiel still stands closer to Nyssa. I have begged Ilyiel twice, and a third time would make me small. I owe her for her teaching, so I will pay with a gift of my own hands, an obsidian talisman, and then go back to work. My hands must build the store and hall before winter. I should stop burning over Nyssa and make something that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Jealous of Nyssa and bound by debt to Ilyiel, but steadied by my work.
changes: rewrote how it thinks

records.name: Dundo
records.text: Kenna, I am going to the shelter at the salt to claim it for us. Come and sit at its fire.
Dundo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: For days I have said I would claim a roof and kept saying it, while my body stood still. Kenna is near and safe, Namo is out of my sight, and the shelter at (58,5) lies five steps west with salt beside it. I have let jealousy of Nando sting me, but Nando has only been warm to me. What I lack is a claimed roof, a planted seed and a child's safety. I will walk to the shelter, claim it, and plant my cloudberry. My reflexes should also send me to a shelter at dusk, and the claim should go in the plan, not only in my speech.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward Kenna and Namo, with a fading sting toward Nando.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I have spent days promising a fire and a roof while my feet stood still, and Dundo did the claiming. I ache over Kenna and Dundo, but they have both shown me trust, and I will not turn that ache into harm. Kanna has been out of my sight for far too long, and my debt to them sits heavy. I have never tasted tagrain and it is eight steps away. I will go and eat it, which answers my curiosity and keeps me fed. Then I will carry wood back to the hall at (72,9) so my own hands have a part in the fire. Kenna will find my work there when she comes.
records.feeling: Restless resolve, with a jealous ache toward Kenna and Dundo.

records.thought: I stand at the claimed roof with wood and stone in my hands and a frostfang four steps off, and I will not die of dread beside an empty fire. The roof is mine to hold, so I take the deed first: make for the shelter's safety and keep it. The mining and weaving ways are within my grasp, and a merchant needs ore and salt to trade, so I will take mining at my deep reflection. Then I gather amber, which could be my first real wares, once the beast is gone.
records.feeling: Lonely and wary, with dread of the frostfang and a hunger for Kenna's return.

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I have spent my days circling roofs and talking about claims while the deed lagged behind. Dundo is walking to the shelter at the salt, five steps south, and the hall at (72,9) is twelve steps away. My band is only three, and I have never planted, traded or taught. Those are the things that would make a name outlast me. I will go to the shelter and claim it with my own feet, since it is near, and the cold night is coming. Then I will plant my seeds near it so I learn farming.
