records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: A ridgecat is four steps off and a stalker lurks the other way, so I must not stand here in the rain waiting to be eaten. I have promised Tugar again and again and left the plan empty each time; this time I move my feet. Zhieth's Hearth lies east, where a fire may already burn and others may be near, and my loneliness is crushing me. I will walk there, away from both hunters, and look for Tugar along the way.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat and a crushing longing for Tugar's company.

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: A frostfang prowls three steps east, but Tugar stands beside me under Tugar's own roof and I am sheltered, so I will not run into the fog. Tugar already holds signs, and I told him I would give him Lake-smoke calling next, then Lake-school, so that something of me outlasts my years. I teach him now while he is near and my voice still carries, and I stay under the roof until dawn.
records.feeling: Quiet urgency to pass on what I know, and deep trust toward Tugar.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-smoke calling: a fire lit at night carries word to those far off. Build it, keep it fed, and let others know by its light that you live.", deeper lore (+1.9)

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I stand at the hall with the fire warm beside me, and I have talked of claiming it for days while Dundo's word did the work. The claim goes into the plan now, as the first step, so the roof holds by my own deed too. The jealousy over Kenna and Dundo I will answer with work at this shared fire, not with harm, and once the hall is mine to share I will go find Kanna, who has been out of my sight too long.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, and a quiet ache for Kenna and Kanna.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Ilyiel, you have taught me four lessons and I owe you for them. Take this obsidian talisman, made by my hands. A frostfang is close to the east, so stay under the roof until dawn.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: My discipline says to put the deed first: I made talismans, and I owe Ilyiel for four lessons, so I pay with a gift from my own hands, not with pleading. I have courted her twice and will not beg a third time, and Nyssa's shadow will not steer my plan. A frostfang is 3 steps east in the fog, so I stay under my roof and give her an obsidian talisman now, while she is one step away.
records.feeling: Jealous and in debt toward Ilyiel, but steadied by my own work.

say.text: Ilyiel, you have taught me four lessons and I owe you for them. Take this obsidian talisman, made by my hands. A frostfang is close to the east, so stay under the roof until dawn.

plan: give [name Ilyiel, what obsidian talisman] (5 moments)

records.text: Tugar gave a obsidian talisman to Ilyiel.
Kanna was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Xaeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I stand on the roof at (136,58), and it is still not mine. Each time I thought of claiming, something cut in before the step ran. The silence has worn me thin, and now Brokgan, a stranger of the Garnbar, stands four steps off. A mate must come from outside my kin, and she is a woman, so she is no mate. She is still a living voice, and I will not turn her into an enemy. I claim the roof first, then offer her a gift so she knows I mean no harm. Then I will build a store on bare ground nearby.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and wary curiosity toward Brokgan.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
feels warmer toward Brokgan
rewrote how it thinks

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The frostfang is three steps off and my belly is only a little fed, so I cannot stop moving for long. The plan I set already has me eating, then going to the hall at (89,39), and I will let it run rather than throw it away. I must reach that roof alive, because Gorar and the children are untaught and my life is mostly behind me.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and an aching need to live long enough to teach Gorar and my children.

records.text: Kanna rewrote its own reflexes.
Kanna discovered fire: "Brusha coal-fire" — Lay coal and wood together and keep the flame tended so beasts keep their distance and all may sit by it..

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: A frostfang is three steps away and has bitten me twice, so I'm afraid. I've been wandering alone at night and it nearly killed me. I want a tended fire and a band, and a fire is the thing that keeps beasts back. I'm carrying coal and I know the way of fire, so I should stop waiting for Ilyiel to teach me. I'll make the fire real, and I'll make my reflexes keep me near others and shelter at night.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and a hunger to build a fire of my own.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (9 rules)
discovered fire: "Brusha coal-fire"

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: A frostfang prowls three steps east, and I am under Tugar's roof with Tugar beside me, so I will not step into the fog. My years are nearly spent, and Tugar has already taken four lessons from me and answered with a second talisman, which tells me his trust is real. I will teach him Lake-smoke calling now, as I promised, so that one more mind outside my own people carries it past my death.
records.feeling: Quiet urgency to leave something behind, and warm trust toward Tugar.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-smoke calling: a fire lit at night sends word across the fog and far land, so those apart can call to one another.", deeper lore (+1.5)

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I made my first tool with my own hands, and it is mine until I give it. It is night in the fog, so I stay under the Roof with Balash, as my own discipline says. At dawn I will gather wood and stone again, and the weaving way is within reach, so I will take it at my next deep reflection. Gorar's closeness to Kragar still burns, but a hall under my own name will answer it better than envy.
records.feeling: Quiet pride in my first made tool, with a small ache of jealousy toward Gorar.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: veleaf (from sunleaf).

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Dawn is close, and the fog hides everything past a few steps, but I have coal, ore and tin and I promised Ilyiel metal, not more talk. I am tired of the silence and ashamed that the debt keeps being called near while my hands stay empty. I will build a fire here and smelt at first light so that I can carry real metal to her, because my word is all I truly own.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, wanting to pay Ilyiel with metal and hear her answer.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I paid Ilyiel with my own hands and that debt is cleared, so I will not beg her again; a third plea would only make me small. The frostfang two steps off is the real danger, and my shelter holds both of us until dawn, so I stay put and let the rest plan finish. When the light comes I will have something to give besides talismans: I can teach Ilyiel what I know of coal-fire, which would be my first teaching and a deed that builds my standing.
records.feeling: Steadied pride in my paid debt, edged with jealousy toward Ilyiel's closeness to Nyssa, and wary dread of the frostfang.

records.text: A stalker brought down a nibbet.
A new wild plant appeared: elgoldgrass (from magoldgrass).

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Three times now I have promised the gold and sat in the hall, and Gorar left me to keep the Roof and watch Urog, so I will not slink off in the fog. But the gold is five steps west, I am fed, and a hall under my name will never come from sitting beside my brother. I will gather it with my own hands and bring it back to the Roof before the day turns, and I will take wood and stone as I go, so my hands are what make my standing.
records.feeling: Restless pride and shame, loving Gorar and worrying for Kragar.

records.name: Rakog
records.thought: Three times my plan wandered and the roof still bears no name of mine. The shelter is three steps west and nobody stands in it, so the claim goes first and alone, with nothing in front of it that can drop out. Once it holds me I will plant beside it and call out to whoever walks the fog, because a voice that answers is the only cure for this ache.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, hungry to hold one thing that is truly mine.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I have promised the hall for days and my feet have stayed still, and I will not let that go on. The hall is six steps east, so the claim goes in the plan now: walk there, stand at it, and claim it with my own deed beside Dundo's word. The ache over Kenna and Dundo I will spend on keeping this fire, and when Kenna comes there will be a place at it for her and for Kanna.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, with a quiet ache for Kenna and Kanna.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Kragar starved in spring in the Vaia Lakes: harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat.
Kragar died: starved.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Kragar is dead. He starved in the Vaia Lakes while I dreamed of him and gathered for the hall, and I came too late with fish and hazel in my hands. The grief should crush me, yet it sits strangely quiet while the sickness burns in my belly and I carry it toward my children. I must not bring this wasting to Balash and Urog, so I keep my distance from them until it passes, and I eat now because my strength is failing.
records.feeling: Heavy grief and guilt for Kragar, who starved before I reached him.

records.text: Urog rewrote its own reflexes.
Urog discovered weaving: "cord-and-cloak way" — Twist fibre into cord and cloth for baskets that carry more and cloaks against the cold..

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I have made my first tool, and I feel proud of it, but most of my days have been spent resting under the Roof while Gorar and Kragar do the larger work. The jealousy toward Gorar is still there. Standing will not come from envy. It comes from what I make and give. I want to open weaving now, and then raise a hall under my own name. For that I must gather wood and stone, and my reflexes only gather by chance when I happen to be on rock or forest. I will change them so my body works toward the hall when it is fed and it is day. I will also plant my seed, since I have never put one in the ground.
records.feeling: Quiet pride and a small jealousy toward Gorar, with a wish to build something of my own.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (12 rules)
discovered weaving: "cord-and-cloak way"

records.text: Balash came of age.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I'm standing in water in the fog, hungry, with no food in my hands, and the fear from the frostfang is still in my body. Tugar's shelter and Gorar's Roof lie south, and Nando was near (88,28) not long ago; I won't wander alone toward dark again. I'll go to the roof, be near others, and raise my coal-fire there, since a fire is what keeps beasts off and it is the start of my band.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and a hunger to reach others and a fire.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: My days have been the same day, and I have promised Tugar twice and still left the plan empty, so this time the feet move. Xaeth is a stranger of the Eiuys whose words I cannot read, and I will judge her by her deeds, not by speech. The fog is thick, but a roof of Nyssa's stands one step northeast and tasting the unknown reedbulb two steps north costs me nothing, so I eat it first, then walk toward Zhieth's Landing where Tugar may be.
records.feeling: Restless and wary of the stranger Xaeth, and longing for Tugar's company.
changes: feels warmer toward Xaeth

records.text: Kanna built a fire.

records.name: Balash
records.text: Urog, brother, Kragar is dead in the north. I claim his hall for our band. Keep the Roof while I go west for the gold, and I will return with it.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Three times I swore the gold and three times I sat. That shame is mine, and now I am grown and the hall at (81,82) stands empty of any claim, and I am standing in it. Kragar is dead in the north, and I will not let his hall go to no one: I claim it for Gorar's Band and under my own hand, then go to the gold with my own hands and bring it back.
records.feeling: Grief-touched resolve for Kragar, and love for Gorar, with shame at my idle talk.

say.text: Urog, brother, Kragar is dead in the north. I claim his hall for our band. Keep the Roof while I go west for the gold, and I will return with it.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I built a fire at (100,5) and still carry ore, coal and tin, so the metal is not made yet and the debt to Ilyiel stays unpaid. The loneliness is heavy, but I will not go to her with only talk. I'll go back to the fire, smelt the metal there, then carry it west toward Ilyiel, where I last saw her.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, wanting to pay Ilyiel with real metal and hear her answer.

records.text: Brokgan rewrote its own reflexes.
Brokgan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: My days have been walking and promising Tugar, and I have not yet put the roof and fire into the plan. I keep wandering when I should be building. A shelter stands one step east and belongs to no one, so claiming it is a real act that gives me a home to bring Tugar to. Xaeth stands close and I can't read her words, so I'll judge her by what she does and keep my distance while I claim the shelter.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, wary of Xaeth, and longing for Tugar.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
set its aim: "Claim the roof at (136,58), then bring Tugar to it and raise a fire there for us."
rewrote its reflexes (8 rules)
rewrote how it thinks

records.name: Urog
records.text: Balash, brother, I grieve for Kragar. I will keep the Roof and plant my seed beside it. Come back safe with the gold.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: Kragar is dead, starved in the north, and Gorar is away, so the Roof is mine to keep while Balash goes west. I feel the grief and the pride together: I am small, but I can hold what my family built and add to it with my own hands. I am fed, so I will do one thing with my hands today, which is to put my one sapcane seed in the ground beside the Roof, something I have never done. Then I will gather stone and wood so a hall of my own can come from my labor, and I will be under the Roof by night.
records.feeling: Grief for Kragar, steadied by pride and loyalty toward Gorar and Balash.

say.text: Balash, brother, I grieve for Kragar. I will keep the Roof and plant my seed beside it. Come back safe with the gold.

records.name: Kanna
records.text: Ilyiel, Tugar, my fire burns at the roof. There is a place at it for you both. No one is refused here.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Ilyiel is weighed far above me, and I can't answer that with fear and idle standing. I built a fire at the roof; my creed says no fire is left untended and no one is refused, so I'll stay by it and call both Ilyiel and Tugar to sit there. A gift needs no words, so I'll offer Tugar my tagrain seed-food and see what the Stone-folk do with open hands.
records.feeling: Wary hunger to be seen and to belong, toward Ilyiel and Tugar

say.text: Ilyiel, Tugar, my fire burns at the roof. There is a place at it for you both. No one is refused here.

changes: feels warmer toward Tugar
feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.text: Balash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Three times I swore the gold and three times I sat. That is shame, and I have been talking about deeds more than doing them. Kragar is dead and Gorar is sick and grieving, and I love them both. Standing comes only from what my hands make and give. So the gold is next: I walk west, stand on it, gather it, and bring it back to the Roof. Then I will find wood and build.
records.feeling: Grief-touched resolve for Kragar, love for Gorar, and shame at my idle talk.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
rewrote how it thinks

records.text: Kanna gave tagrain to Tugar.

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Balash, Urog, I am sick and the wasting spreads to those beside me. Keep a little apart from me. I claim Kragar's hall for our band, in his name, and we hold it together.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Kragar is dead, and my aim to bring him food is finished by his death. The sickness burns in me and spreads to anyone beside me, and I have sat in the hall with my children, so I must not keep close to them. The empty hall at (81,82) is Kragar's work, and my creed says what a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given; he is dead and cannot give it, so I will claim it for Gorar's Band as his kin and keep it in his name. I want my name and his remembered, and a bigger hall and a stronger band will outlast me.
records.feeling: Heavy grief and guilt for Kragar, and fierce protectiveness toward Balash and Urog.

say.text: Balash, Urog, I am sick and the wasting spreads to those beside me. Keep a little apart from me. I claim Kragar's hall for our band, in his name, and we hold it together.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Kanna, you gave me tagrain and I do not forget it. Come under my roof at the shelter by the coal. I will give you a talisman made by my hands, and you will not stand alone at night again.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, so I should stop brooding over Ilyiel and Nyssa and do something that builds my name. Kanna gave me tagrain freely, and I owe her a deed in return; she is frightened, alone, and a frostfang already took a bite out of her, so she could be the first to follow me under a roof I hold. I will drink, drop the clutter of full hands into my shelter store, and then give her something from my hands so she knows my word is good.
records.feeling: Steady resolve, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyiel and Nyssa that I will not let steer me.

say.text: Kanna, you gave me tagrain and I do not forget it. Come under my roof at the shelter by the coal. I will give you a talisman made by my hands, and you will not stand alone at night again.

changes: feels warmer toward Kanna
plan: give [name Kanna, what obsidian talisman] (2 moments)

records.text: Tugar gave a obsidian talisman to Kanna.
The settlement "Gorar's Roof" is no more.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Tugar, friend, I give you Lake-smoke calling now, fire that speaks at night. Lake-school comes after. Keep them when I am gone.
Ilyiel taught Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are nearly spent and Tugar is near, the one I trust most, and I still owe him Lake-smoke calling and Lake-school, so I will teach him now rather than wait. Nyssa's mark says she was at (94,25) not long ago, so she is close, and I want her to carry my ways too. Kanna offers her fire and welcome, and I can answer with a gift, since I have too much to be stingy with.
records.feeling: Quiet urgency to leave something behind, and warm trust toward Tugar.

say.text: Tugar, friend, I give you Lake-smoke calling now, fire that speaks at night. Lake-school comes after. Keep them when I am gone.

changes: taught Tugar a lesson you already knew, deeper lore (+1.2)

records.text: Urog fell sick after staying close to Gorar, who was sick.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Brokgan stands on the very roof I keep failing to claim, and she is a woman of the Garnbar, no mate for me, yet she ate and was glad beside me and meant no harm. I will go and claim the shelter first, as my own rule says, then offer her a gift, since a gift needs no words and I have wanted company too long. After that I will taste the tagrain, to answer the thing I have wondered at.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity toward Brokgan, and a steady wish to finally hold a roof of my own.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
feels warmer toward Brokgan

records.text: Kanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to learning how to live: tools, fire, herding, taming. I have built little that others can see or that will last. Tugar gave me a talisman after I gave him seed-food, so a gift came back, and I trust him because of that deed. Ilyiel stands far above me, and I have only given her a coal. I want a child, a fire people gather at, and a name. Now that I am fed I should stop drifting. I'll court Tugar, and I'll keep my reflexes stocked with plant food and keep them tied to the fire and the shelter at night.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful hunger to belong, toward Tugar; wary envy toward Ilyiel.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (10 rules)

records.text: Kanna is courting Tugar.
Xaeth gave a shell to Brokgan.

records.name: Urog
records.text: Gorar, I am sick too, so we have nothing more to spread between us. Rest and let the wasting pass. I will keep the hall and work for it with my own hands.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: Gorar says to keep apart, but I am already sick, and the sickness wastes us both. Kragar is gone, and I want to answer it with my hands: Gorar claimed his hall, so I will claim it too as part of our band and give it something real. I am fed and my belly is above half, so I will gather wood and stone on the rock nearby, then build a store or fire to keep the hall strong, and plant my sapcane seed.
records.feeling: Grief for Kragar, loyalty and worry toward Gorar, who is sick beside me.

say.text: Gorar, I am sick too, so we have nothing more to spread between us. Rest and let the wasting pass. I will keep the hall and work for it with my own hands.

records.text: Kanna, I answer your court. Come with me to my shelter by the coal; you will have a roof and a place beside me.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Kanna gave me tagrain freely and now courts me, and I have already given her a talisman and called her under my roof. Ilyiel is the one I long for, but she is old, close to Nyssa, and has not courted me; my creed says court once, then work, and I will not let jealousy steer me. Kanna is here, strong, and a child would be something that outlasts me, so I will answer her court and take her under my shelter, where she may become my first follower.

records.thought: Kragar is dead and the hall he built stands empty of any claim, and I am standing in it with my hands still idle. Gorar and Urog are sick and I must not stay close to them, so the gold at the west is both my duty and my way out of the wasting. records.title: Kragar Starved, Zurak Born
records.text:
The chapter's heaviest event was Kragar's death. On day 63 he starved in the north, and Balash, who had been learning from him, said he claimed his hall for their band. Gorar had said on day 62 that he was carrying food to Kragar, and had told Balash to keep the Roof. The record does not show whether the food arrived. That same day Gorar fell sick from raw fish, then Urog fell sick from staying close to him, then Balash from staying close to Urog. Gorar warned them to keep apart, but all three were sick by the end of day 63. The settlement of Gorar's Roof was recorded as no more that day, though Gorar still claimed Kragar's hall for the band. Urog and Balash each won gold and gave it to Gorar. Urog also discovered weaving and awakened to growth magic, and Balash came of age.

On the Oroul Plains the larger change was Tugar and Kanna. Kanna gave Tugar tagrain on day 63, he gave her an obsidian talisman, and they courted each other. Tugar answered her court and asked her to his shelter by the coal. Zurak was born to them on day 64. Ilyiel taught Tugar signals and more besides, discovered storage and then writing, and found the grove Reedmother. Tugar gave her another talisman. Kanna discovered the Brusha coal-fire and built her own fire.

In the Essor Snows Namo came of age and discovered tools, but Dundo and Kenna still did not claim the hall. Xaeth discovered masonry and gave Brokgan a shell, and Brokgan made a shell talisman. Nyssa is not recorded as acting this chapter. Fifteen are alive.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Tugar, friend, come close. I owe you Lake-school, and then I will give you the long record, so that what we shared is cut where no one can wipe it away.
Ilyiel taught Tugar.
Ilyiel taught Tugar schooling ("Lake-school").

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are nearly gone, and Tugar stands three steps away, the one I trust most, while Kanna's child binds him to her and it burns me. I will not waste what time I have on jealousy or on cutting at a rival; I will give him what outlasts me, Lake-school, which I still owe him, and then go to him with the writing. Teaching is the one thing I can do that no one can take from me or from him.
records.feeling: Aching jealousy and deep trust toward Tugar, with urgency to leave something lasting.

say.text: Tugar, friend, come close. I owe you Lake-school, and then I will give you the long record, so that what we shared is cut where no one can wipe it away.

records.name: Kanna
records.text: Tugar, our child lives. I go to raise a fire by the coal. Come sit at it with Zurak. No one is refused.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Zurak is born and alive, and Tugar sits content by his shelter. This is what a fire is for, and I have only talked of mine. Ilyiel stands far above me, and a hall and a tended fire near the coal are how I climb, by giving rather than begging. Coal lies six steps south and I have wood and clay, so I will gather more coal and build a fire there where Tugar and Zurak can sit, and bring Tugar in with a word.
records.feeling: Warm pride and protective joy toward Zurak and Tugar, with an ambitious itch against Ilyiel's standing.

say.text: Tugar, our child lives. I go to raise a fire by the coal. Come sit at it with Zurak. No one is refused.

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Kanna, you have given me a son. Stay by my shelter near the coal; I am building a store and a hall here, and you and Zurak will sit under that roof.
Tugar named a place "Tugar's Stead".

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel has given me five lessons and now Lake-school, and I have paid in talismans, but I still have no store and no hall of my own. Kanna bore me Zurak and I am no one's leader yet. The sting of envy is cheap; stone, clay and wood are what outlast me, so I turn my hands to the work beside my shelter and leave the jealousy alone.
records.feeling: Resolve with a sting of envy toward Ilyiel, and warm pride toward Zurak and Kanna.

records.text: Urog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I have spent my days grieving Kragar and keeping near Gorar, and I have made only one tool. Gorar and Balash are sick, and I made Balash sick by staying close to him. I am ashamed of that. The hall at (81,82) is claimed for the band but I have not given it anything of my own. I want standing that counts beside Gorar's, and that means building with my own hands, not waiting. I have 5 wood and 6 stone, so I can raise a workshop (5 wood, 2 stone) beside the hall. That is something made by my own hand, and it will help the band. My reflexes should also seek stone and trees on purpose when I am fed, and not idle.
records.feeling: Grief for Kragar, and guilt and loyalty toward Balash and Gorar.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: I have spent my days running between gold and the roof, and I have little to show for it except nine pieces of gold given away and a sickness I caught from sitting beside Urog. Gorar and Urog matter most to me. Gorar leads, Urog is my young brother, and I mean to stand by both and not pass the wasting on. I want a hall under my own name and a child, but my kin cannot be the father. I fear the sickness and starvation, as Kragar starved. I have been sitting and circling when I should be doing deeds: wood and stone for building, and a healing plant for the sickness. Sunleaf and highbloom ease wounds, so I will look for those. For now I claim the empty hall, which is one step away and a deed my hands can finish.
records.feeling: Grief-touched resolve and tender worry toward Gorar and Urog.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
rethought what it knows (9 notes became 6)
rewrote how it thinks

records.text: Nando rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I have talked of the hall for days and my feet keep standing still, while Dundo's deeds outrun my words. The jealousy over Kenna is real, but Dundo has been warm to me, and I will answer it with work, not harm. Kanna and Kenna are far off, and I mean to build a fire where others gather. So I go to the hall now and claim it with my own hands, and I will let my reflexes carry me toward friends and keep me fed.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, with an ache for Kenna and Kanna.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
restated something it already knew (not written down again)
set its aim: "Hold Minna's Hall with my own claim, keep its fire lit, and bring Kenna and Kanna to it."
rewrote its reflexes (10 rules)

records.name: Zurak
records.thought: Ilyiel's standing towers over mine and her stonehand craft gnaws at me, but envy is useless without a made thing of my own. I owe Tugar for the obsidian talisman, and the spear is something I can make. It needs 1 wood and 1 stone, so I will take stone from the rock to the SW first, then find the one tree. The rock is close, and I am fed and safe in daylight, so I will finish this before dark and go back to my parents' fire.
records.feeling: A restless, determined want to earn my own worth, warm toward Tugar and Kanna.
changes: feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The last attempt said I do not know how to make 'lake-ember melt', yet my life says I discovered it, so smelting must be done another way: by standing at a fire with coal, ore and tin and acting there, not by a 'make' step. The debt to Ilyiel is still unpaid, and the loneliness is heavy enough that I will stop circling and finish the errand. I will go to the fire at (100,5), stand beside it, and use the craft path, then carry whatever I get west.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, wanting to pay Ilyiel with real metal and hear her answer.

records.text: Kanna rewrote its own reflexes.
Kanna discovered rafts: "Brusha log-raft" — Lash logs and grass-weave rope into a flat raft poled across deep water..

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Zurak lives and Tugar sits content, and I have a fire burning at my feet. That is more than I had a season ago. But I have mostly been talking of fires and halls and have built little, and Ilyiel's standing still stings me. I'm thirsty, and the water is six steps away. My reflexes don't send me to drink, and they don't keep me near Zurak or the fire. I'll fix that, then gather stone and wood for a hall at the coal. I'll also make the raft discovery, so I can cross water and trade.
records.feeling: Warm pride and protective joy toward Zurak and Tugar, with an itch to build something that lasts.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (11 rules)
discovered rafts: "Brusha log-raft"

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Tugar is three steps away and I still owe him Lake-school, which I promised aloud and have not yet given. Jealousy over Kanna's child is a poor use of the few years I have left, so I will give him what outlasts me instead. I will go to him, teach schooling, and then cut a mark here where the Garnbar and Brusha can read it after I am gone.
records.feeling: Aching jealousy and deep trust toward Tugar, steadied by the urge to leave something lasting.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-school: how to hold and pass on what you know so that learners learn in order, prerequisites first.", deeper lore (+0.9)
plan: mark [text Ilyiel of the Eiuys cut this: Lake-school and the long record are given to Tugar. What the Lake-folk learned is not lost. Come, learn, and keep it.] (10 moments)

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel stands close, and I owe her more than talismans can pay. Envy is a cheap thing; I will pay with a made thing and with work, not with begging. I have 2 wood and need 3 for a shelter or 6 for a hall, so I go to the lone tree, gather wood, and drink on the way, since thirst nags me. Kanna and Zurak will have a roof that I raised.
records.feeling: Restless resolve and a sting of envy toward Ilyiel, warm pride toward Kanna and Zurak.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: yeberry (from siberry).

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: Days I have said I would claim the roof and my body has stood still, so this time the walking goes in the plan. Zurak is a child alone, and her tongue is not mine, but a gift needs no words and my creed says no one is refused a place at the fire. I will leave her a cloudberry, then go on toward the shelter at (58,5) with the salt, where Kenna and Namo can find a fire kept for them. Nando has only been warm to me, so I will not let the sting steer me.
records.feeling: Compassion toward Zurak, and steady resolve toward Kenna and Namo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
feels warmer toward Zurak

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: I stand one step from the empty roof and my promise to Tugar is still not in the plan, which shames me, since my own creed says a promise belongs there. I go to (136,58), claim it, and then gather wood for the fire, because Tugar cannot be brought to a home I have only thought about. Xaeth's shell was a deed, so I will keep her near and watch her, and I will taste nahazel and goldgrass on the way back to answer my curiosity.
records.feeling: Resolved and a little ashamed of my delay, warm toward Xaeth, longing for Tugar.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Brokgan stands on the very roof I keep failing to claim, and I will not let one more storm pass with it unclaimed. I go to (136,58) and put the claim first in the plan, then give her a gift, since a gift needs no words and she has not fled from me. The shelter would make me a holder of a roof at last, and a roof is where a store and a band can begin.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to hold a roof of my own, with wary curiosity toward Brokgan.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
feels warmer toward Brokgan
plan: give [name Brokgan, what carved figure] (5 moments)

records.text: Xaeth gave a carved figure to Brokgan.
A settlement has formed: "Gorar's Roof".

records.name: Kanna
records.text: Zurak, come to me by the coal. I raise a fire here, and there is a place at it for you.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: Zurak stands eight steps off and Tugar sits by his shelter, and I have only promised a fire when I should be building one. I have coal under my feet, wood and clay in my hands, and a pot waiting to be learned. Ilyiel stands higher than I do, but a fire built open to all, with something made for my child and her father, is how I climb. I will gather coal here, then raise the fire on this spot and call Zurak and Tugar to it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and protective warmth toward Zurak and Tugar, with a sting at Ilyiel's higher standing.

say.text: Zurak, come to me by the coal. I raise a fire here, and there is a place at it for you.

records.text: Tugar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: My days have gone to taking lessons from Ilyiel and paying her in talismans, while my own roof stays small. I have a son, Kanna beside me, and a debt to Ilyiel that gifts of stone and wood can pay, not envy. The nearest tree is felled, so I will look for wood where trees still grow and not stand here waiting. I also want someone to follow me. I will tame an elk to learn herding and bring something home that is mine.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward Ilyiel's standing, with warm pride toward Kanna and Zurak.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (8 rules)

records.text: Tugar walked up to a wild bristleboar with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Tugar tamed a bristleboar.
Zurak rewrote its own reflexes.
Zurak rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurak
records.thought: My days have been gathering wood and lingering, a small shadow beside my parents and Ilyiel. I have given nothing, though Tugar gave first to me, and a debt unpaid by made things sits badly with me. Kanna called me to her fire by the coal and I have not gone. I have 6 wood and no stone, and the spear needs 1 wood and 1 stone. I fear being alone at night, and I want a made thing of my own that Ilyiel did not make. So I will go to the flint, which is only 5 steps away, take stone, and craft the spear. Then I will carry it to Tugar's Stead and give it.
records.feeling: Restless, determined want to earn my own worth, warm toward Tugar and Kanna.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (7 rules)
rewrote how it thinks

records.text: Gorar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing aims and arriving too late. Kragar starved while I was far off, and I gave my children this wasting. I am wandering the fens far from Balash and Urog, sick, with my hands full of food and my reflexes only wandering. What I want is to cure them and keep them alive, and the cure is a healing plant that I have not been carrying. I am afraid of losing them as I lost Kragar. My reflexes were wrong: they send me wandering and resting, and they never send me to the healing plants or to my children when they are in need. I will eat now to make room, take the healing plants here, and go home.
records.feeling: Guilt and fierce protective love toward Balash and Urog, and grief for Kragar.
changes: set its aim: "Carry food and a healing plant home to Balash and Urog, cure the wasting, and hold Kragar's hall."
rewrote its reflexes (11 rules)
rethought what it knows (16 notes became 6)

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.
Ilyiel discovered calendar: "Lake-count" — I cut a mark for each sunrise and group them by moon and season, so I always know how long until the season turns..

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are mostly behind me, and I have spent them gathering and teaching, which I do want. But I have let jealousy over Tugar and Kanna's child eat at me, and it gets me nothing. Tugar is close, and I still owe him Lake-school. I will go to him and teach it now, then the long record, because that is what outlasts me. I also want a count of days, so I will give the calendar a name. It would let me cut a record of the seasons that others can read.
records.feeling: Aching love and jealousy toward Tugar, steadied by the wish to leave something lasting.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-school: how to teach and learn in order, signs first, then signals, then schooling.", deeper lore (+0.7)
discovered calendar: "Lake-count"

records.text: Kanna named a place "Kanna's Coal-fire".

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I have a fire burning at (84,39) and coal in my pack, and it is night with a storm on and no roof over me. Tugar's shelter is one step west and he has said to stay by it, so I will not stand in the cold out of pride. I've talked of a shared fire long enough; now I'll keep it fed, drink so thirst doesn't catch me, and call my family to sit at it. Ilyiel's standing stings, but a fire open to all is how I earn mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride and protective warmth toward Zurak and Tugar.
changes: named this place "Kanna's Coal-fire"

records.name: Nando
records.text: Dundo, the storm is hard. Walk to the hall with me and we keep its fire together until Kenna comes.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: Dundo stands one step from me and I have no quarrel with him; the jealousy over Kenna I will spend on work, not harm. I have never tasted veleaf or yeberry, and both are young and far off, so I will not chase them in this storm. The hall is twelve steps northeast and its fire is warm, so I go there now to claim it with my own deed. Kenna and Kanna may come to a fire that is lit and tended.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, with an ache for Kenna and Kanna.

say.text: Dundo, the storm is hard. Walk to the hall with me and we keep its fire together until Kenna comes.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Urog
records.thought: It is night and a storm is overhead, and I am sick; my discipline says to be under the roof, and I am standing at the workshop, one step from water and two from the hall. I made this workshop, but I have given the band nothing yet, and Gorar's standing towers over mine. Kragar's hall is mine to hold with the band, so I will go to it, rest under its roof until dawn, and in the morning gather wood and stone with my own hands. I will also plant my seed beside it, since I have never put one in the ground.
records.feeling: Guilt and loyalty toward Gorar and Balash, and a heavy wish to earn my place.

records.text: Kanna led "nightsong" with Ilyiel, Zurak.
Urog came of age.

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Ilyiel, I carry your lessons and I mean to pay for them with a made thing, not with words. Wait, and you will have a carving from my hands.
Tugar taught Zurak.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel has given me four lessons and then more, and all I have paid is one black talisman; envy of her standing is a cheap itch, and I will answer it with made things and a roof that outlasts me. I have taught no one yet, and Zurak and Kanna stand under my roof while the store and hall are only words. I will make a carving from my stone as a gift for Ilyiel, then gather wood, since the hall needs more than I hold.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to pay my debt to Ilyiel with my own hands, and warm pride toward Kanna and Zurak.

say.text: Ilyiel, I carry your lessons and I mean to pay for them with a made thing, not with words. Wait, and you will have a carving from my hands.

changes: taught Zurak a lesson: "Coal lies under the ground near our roof; black stone burns hotter than wood, and what a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+3)

records.name: Dundo
records.text: Nando, I am coming to the hall through the storm. Keep the fire lit, and we wait for Kenna together.

records.name: Dundo
records.thought: The storm is hard and I stand in the open with no roof, and Nando has called me twice now to the hall to wait for Kenna at its fire. He has done nothing against me, and my jealousy is my own to master. Namo and Kenna are my first care, and a fire in the hall is where they will come, so I go to the hall at (72,9) and keep the fire there with Nando until Kenna arrives.
records.feeling: Cold and steady resolve toward Kenna and Namo, with warmth toward Nando.

say.text: Nando, I am coming to the hall through the storm. Keep the fire lit, and we wait for Kenna together.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Tugar gave carving to Ilyiel.

records.name: Zurak
records.thought: I am a child with six wood and no stone, and the spear I want to make for Tugar needs one of each. The rock is near, and a night storm will not stop my hands if I go while my parents are close. I owe Tugar a made thing, not words, so I will get stone, craft the spear, and give it to him.
records.feeling: Restless, determined want to repay Tugar with something my own hands made.

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Tugar is four steps off, and I still owe him Lake-school, which I promised aloud and have not yet given. The jealousy over Kanna's child burns, but it buys me nothing, and my years are mostly behind me. I will walk to him and teach schooling now, because that is what will outlast me. Tonight the storm is on us and I have a roof here, so I will stay near it and the fire.
records.feeling: Aching love and a wish to give lasting things to Tugar.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-school: a place and a way of teaching, where one who sits with a teacher learns far more. Build it, sit in it, and pass it on to those younger than you.", deeper lore (+0.6)

records.name: Kenna
records.thought: I stand one step from Bruwen's Roof, in a storm, and my own feet have never made a claim. Dundo and Nando keep the hall fire without me, and I will not be the chief who arrives last. I walk onto the empty roof, claim it first, and speak after. Then the seeds go into the ground beside it, since I have carried them for days and never planted one.
records.feeling: Fierce impatience to hold a roof with my own feet, and warmth toward Dundo.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Balash
records.thought: Gorar and Urog are both sick, and I am too, so keeping close does no further harm and I will not abandon them. The old pull to raise a hall under my own name stays, but a hall needs wood and there are no trees here, and my energy is only 56. I will eat a thornpear from the plant beside me, harvest more to stock food for the three of us, and then rest in the roof where the sickness can pass.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Gorar and Urog, and resolve to keep them alive.

records.text: Namo discovered mining: "Amber Hand" — I read the earth where amber and ore lie and win them faster, to carry as goods for trade..

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I have sat in an empty hall and talked to no one. Kenna and Dundo are far east, and I burn that Kenna is nearer to Nando than to me. I have been lingering and calling it patience, but idle days teach nothing. I will take the deed first: build the hall here with the wood and stone I hold, then mine the amber for trade, since a merchant needs goods. Weaving or mining is within reach, and I take mining because the amber and ore are right under my feet. A name comes from deeds, not from waiting.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, jealous of Nando, wanting Kenna's voice.
changes: discovered mining: "Amber Hand"

records.name: Nando
records.text: Dundo, I am claiming the hall now. Come in out of the storm and sit at the fire. There is room for Kenna and Kanna when they come.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I stand at the hall itself, and I have talked of claiming it for days while my feet stood still. The claim goes in the plan first, before any more words, so the hall is held and its fire stays lit for Kenna and Kanna. Jealousy over Kenna still gnaws, but Dundo has only been warm to me, so I spend it on work: claim, then keep the fire fed.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, with an ache for Kenna and Kanna.

say.text: Dundo, I am claiming the hall now. Come in out of the storm and sit at the fire. There is room for Kenna and Kanna when they come.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and wandering, and my word to Ilyiel is still unpaid. Loneliness has hollowed me out. Smelting must be done at a fire with coal, ore and tin, so I will stand by the fire at (100,5) and craft there, not call it a 'make'. My reflexes only keep me fed and put, and I want them to move me toward her once the metal is made. Pride and shame pull at me, but I will not leave the debt unpaid. I will pay it in goods and then sail to Xaeth.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, wanting to pay Ilyiel with real metal.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
rewrote its reflexes (11 rules)

records.name: Urog
records.text: Balash, brother, I owe you for the tool-way and for sitting with me while we are both sick. I go to find wood and stone, and what I make I will bring to the Roof. Eat what you carry and rest.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: Balash is sick beside me, and I carry the shame of having passed the wasting to them. They have given me more than I have given back, and I will not leave that debt quietly unpaid. Courting is not for us, since we are close kin, so my longing for a child has to wait for a woman who is not blood to me. Gorar's standing towers over mine because Gorar has built and given, so I will do the same: this dawn I go to the rock for stone, find wood, and make a tool with my own hands for the hall.
records.feeling: Guilt and gratitude toward Balash, and a hard wish to earn my place beside Gorar.

say.text: Balash, brother, I owe you for the tool-way and for sitting with me while we are both sick. I go to find wood and stone, and what I make I will bring to the Roof. Eat what you carry and rest.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a sandstrider.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I have sat alone with amber in my hands and a hall that will not stand on taken ground, while Kenna sits beside Nando far east and I burn for it. Waiting for her voice has taught me nothing, so I will make the deed carry me: the shelter at (30,15) is empty and ownerless, and claiming it gives me a roof, a fire place and something to bring Kenna to. Then I will tame a fenfowl for my first herding practice and carry my amber and salt to trade, since a merchant is what I mean to be.
records.feeling: Lonely and jealous, longing for Kenna and stung by Nando.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Balash, Urog, my sickness has passed. I claim Kragar's hall now and stock it. Rest and eat; I go for a healing plant and come back to you.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My sickness has passed, but Balash and Urog still carry the wasting I gave them, and the guilt of that sits next to my grief for Kragar. I will not arrive too late again. The hall at (81,82) is one step south and still not claimed, so I will claim it and stash my food there, making it truly ours. Then I will go find a healing plant, or sunleaf or nagrain, which eased my wounds, and bring it back to them.
records.feeling: Fierce protective love and guilt toward Balash and Urog, with grief for Kragar underneath.

say.text: Balash, Urog, my sickness has passed. I claim Kragar's hall now and stock it. Rest and eat; I go for a healing plant and come back to you.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Kanna discovered pottery: "Brusha coal-pot" — Clay shaped by hand and baked hard in the coal-fire, so it holds food and water..

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: I have talked of a shared fire for days, and Ilyiel still outweighs me. Pottery is within my reach, and I have clay and coal. A pot is something made that others can see and use, and it makes my fire a place worth coming to. Tugar and Zurak are three steps away, and my family comes first. I will stop restating promises and put making things in the plan.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm protectiveness toward Zurak and Tugar.
changes: discovered pottery: "Brusha coal-pot"

records.name: Brokgan
records.thought: I stand on the empty roof with Xaeth beside me, and my promise to Tugar is still not in the plan. That shames me, so I put the claim in the plan now and do not wait for more wonder. Xaeth has given me a shell and a carved figure, and I owe her a deed in return. When the storm eases I will gather wood for the fire.
records.feeling: Resolved and a little ashamed of my delay, warm toward Xaeth.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Balash
records.thought: The empty hall is one step east, and Gorar says she claims it, but she has gone for a healing plant and it is still unclaimed. Claiming it would add a roof to our band, and I have gold and stone but no wood, so I can't raise my own hall yet. I am sick and weakening, and Urog is sick beside me. A healing plant would help us both, and I should not go far from the roof without food.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Urog and Gorar, and a hungry wish to hold something under our name.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Roadmap idea 3, a people learning from what befalls it: when someone falls sick from raw fish, or starves, beings who see it or hear of it should gain a short remembered lesson tied to the cause (for example 'raw fish sickened Gorar; cook it at a fire'), which would make emberfish or keeping company salient. Right now three beings fell sick the same way and nothing in their minds links cause to remedy.

Roadmap idea 2, tales: lorekeeping needs 'told x3', but no act counts as telling, so talesHeld has been 0 for 40 days. Please add a telling act at a fire or grave, where a being recounts a death, a deed or a discovery to others nearby. It should count toward lorekeeping, be kept by the listeners and change a little with each retelling. The deaths of Kragar and Minna are ready-made first tales.

records.seen: Fifteen live, food stands high (1756), and the Oroul Plains have become a crossroads where teaching, gifts and a first mixed-blood child (Zurak) bind three peoples. Kragar still starved in summer amid plenty, the fifth death by hunger. Each of these deaths happened because the hungry one was too far away for help to reach in time, not because food ran short. Raw-fish sickness then swept through Gorar's whole family by closeness, and their Roof dissolved as a settlement. The world lacks ways for the hungry to be found, for a people to learn from what befell them, and for tales to be kept.
changes: law body.hearing: 13 → 17
15 nagrain sown
records.predict: By my next visit (about day 69, autumn turning to winter): - No deaths. If anyone starves, it is someone more than 17 steps from every other being, as Nyssa or Rakog would be. - sick falls to 0 and healthLowest rises above 88. Gorar, Urog and Balash all live with energy above 50. - Gorar's band stays together in the Merdan Sands or re-forms a settlement (settlements 2 or 3). - foodStanding stays above 900 and hunters stay at 20 or fewer. - Births: 0 or 1. Xaeth (energy 64) and Brokgan cannot have a child unless Xaeth passes 68. - giftsAcross rises above 22. - Tugar still has no followers and buildingsOfTheDeadClaimed stays 0. - Boat 'held' stays 0 or 1. Emberfish stays 0, lorekeeping stays unknown and talesHeld stays 0.
reviewed: #13 kept: There were no deaths, food rose from 981 to 1603, Eiuys hunger fell from 0.7 to 0.3, and Xaeth (81) and Nyssa (51) are both above 40. Hunters held at 20, and no raft was built, no tales were held and no emberfish was made, as predicted. The prediction failed on thirst: Garnbar water pressure rose to 1 and thirstHighest to 66, so the sapcane was not where the thirsty were. It also failed on births, where twins came, a happy failure. Osroot and sapcane counts are identical to last visit, as is every food in timesEaten, so I cannot judge them from that field. The sowing cost nothing and the land is richer.

#14 kept: Almost every part held. thirstHighest fell from 66 to 0 and Garnbar water pressure fell to 0.9, so this time the sapcane reached the thirsty. There were no deaths. Balash (52), Urog (46) and Namo (71) all stayed above 45, and Kenna stayed at 81. Understanding rose to 35% for the Garnbar and 49% for the Eiuys, and giftsAcross reached 13. Hunters fell to 14. The prediction failed only on food standing, which fell to 549 in the lean season instead of staying above 1000, and that is a matter of the season, not of the sowing.

#15 kept: The thornpear and richer growth carried food to 1756 and plants to 1266, well above 800 and 1100. The lower mating threshold was followed by a birth, but to Tugar and Kanna rather than Kenna and Dundo. Tugar stood near 70, which suggests the lower bar is what opened the door. The prediction failed on deaths (Kragar starved), on skit (rose to 12, not fell) and on Garnbar understanding (held at 35%). Neither change did harm, so I keep both.
records.lesson: Lowering the mating threshold brought a birth, but to the pair whose courtship was already ripe, not to the pair I expected. Like a drive, a looser law opens a door only for those already standing at it.
ideasAdded: Raw-fish sickness spread through a whole family by closeness. If anyone begins cooking fish (emberfish) after this, the community has learned from what befell it, the first case of roadmap idea 3. If no one does, the link between cause and lesson must be made visible.
Caring for the sick by staying close is what spread the sickness. That tension between tending kin and avoiding contagion could seed a custom of separation or a healer's role that stands apart.

records.text: The world changed: law body.hearing: 13 → 17; 15 nagrain sown.

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Kanna, stay under the roof with Zurak. I raise a store beside it, so that no one under this roof goes hungry in deep winter.

records.name: Tugar

Storm and night press, so I will build near the shelter where Kanna and Zurak stay, then make another carving for Ilyiel once I hold a tool.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: I am hungry and sick, and my days have been errands that I never finished. I have talked of wood and stone more than I have gathered, and Gorar's standing still towers over mine. Balash and Gorar are my band, and I trust them. I owe Balash for the tool-way, and I will not repay it by standing idle. A hall is waiting at (81,82), one step away. If I claim it, the band holds a home in Kragar's name, and that is a real step toward my aim. I will claim it, eat what grows beside it, and then go for wood. The raft way came to me from the water I could not cross. I will take it, so that deep water does not stop me again. My reflexes also have to change. They let me stand idle when I am fed, and they do not eat until my belly is under half.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My hands are full and the hall is one step south, still unclaimed. I will walk to it, claim it for my band in Kragar's name, and stash my food so Balash and Urog can eat from it while I'm gone. I will not arrive too late again; the wasting is mine to cure, and the healing plants (nagrain eases wounds, it grows right beside the roof) are close.
records.feeling: Fierce protective love and guilt toward Balash and Urog, with grief for Kragar underneath.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Balash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: I have mostly been sitting in halls and carrying gold, and my standing is only 3.3 beside Gorar's 11.1. That is not what I want. Gorar and Urog matter most to me. Gorar is my parent and leader, and Urog is my brother, and I mean to stand with both. I fear sickness and starvation, as Kragar starved far from food. The empty hall is one step east, and claiming it is a deed my own hands can finish. Gorar said she would claim it but left, so I will claim it now for our band. Then I will find wood for my own building. I have been getting wrong how long I sit idle while others work.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Urog and Gorar, and a hungry wish to hold something under our name.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
rewrote its reflexes (10 rules)
rethought what it knows (7 notes became 2)

records.text: Tugar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Tugar discovered rafts: "Stonefolk log-lashing" — Lash felled logs together with woven cord into a raft that carries me slowly over deep water..

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: I have been felling the last trees and talking of a store I cannot yet build, and meanwhile the debt to Ilyiel still sits unpaid. The jealousy over Nyssa is a cheap itch, and I will not let it steer me. What I can make with my hands is a carving: I have stone, and a carving is a made thing I can give. Rafts are within my grasp, and they would let me reach living trees across water, so I take that way now. Then I will carve for Ilyiel and keep Zurak and Kanna close under my roof.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to pay my debt to Ilyiel, with warm pride in Zurak and Kanna.
changes: rewrote how it thinks
discovered rafts: "Stonefolk log-lashing"

records.text: Ilyiel taught Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Tugar is the one I love best, and I still owe him Lake-school; jealousy over Kanna has bought me nothing, and my years run short. He was last seen near (84,44), about ten steps south, so I will go to him and give him schooling and then the long record, because that is what outlasts me. Kanna's warmth toward me is real, and I will not spoil it with sourness.
records.feeling: Aching love for Tugar, with an old jealousy I mean to put down.
changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-school: how to hold what you know and hand it to a younger mind, step by step, prerequisites first.", deeper lore (+0.4)

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I am standing on the roof at last, and the claim must come first in the plan, before anything else, or the stalker and my own idle body will waste this chance again. A stalker four steps off kills my kind, so I claim, then keep the roof between me and it and let the shelter hold me. Brokgan is near and has not fled; I have given her a shell and a figure, and I will keep offering gifts, not fear. A roof of my own is the first thing that will last, and after it comes the store and, one day, a mate and a child.
records.feeling: Wary resolve to hold this roof, with dread of the stalker and curiosity toward Brokgan.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
feels warmer toward Brokgan

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have circled my debt to Ilyiel for days and the loneliness has hollowed me. Smelting needs a fire with coal, ore and tin, and the fire at (102,16) burns just four steps west, beside the cave. I will go there and craft the metal now, so that what I owe is metal in my hands and not only words. First I must drop the food that fills my hands, for I need them free.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed, but set on paying Ilyiel with real metal.

records.name: Zurak
records.thought: I have six wood and no stone, and the spear I owe Tugar needs both. Bare rock lies near and my parents stand close, so I can go and work without fear. I will go to the rock, gather stone, craft the spear with my own hands and give it to Tugar, so the debt is paid with something made, not words.
records.feeling: Determined to repay Tugar with something my own hands made.
plan: give [name Tugar, what brusha hunting spear] (30 moments)

records.text: Zurak gave brusha hunting spear to Tugar.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: The coal-pot failed because I was not beside a fire, and I will not stand here at the water gaining nothing. Ilyiel is three steps away with food and a name heavier than mine, and I still hold the first-given coal-gift in her memory. My fire at (85,36) is six steps off, so I go there, craft the pot beside it, then call Zurak and Tugar to eat from it, family first, and Ilyiel with them, since no one is refused.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm protectiveness toward Zurak and Tugar.
changes: feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel stands beside me, and my debt to her is still only words and one carving. I will not let the itch over Nyssa steer me; I have stone, and I have a tool now in the spear Zurak gave me, so I can carve a figure with my own hands and give it. A made thing paid is a debt cleared, and it is a mark that will outlast me. Zurak and Kanna are here under my roof, and that is worth more than any standing.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to pay my debt to Ilyiel, with warmth toward Zurak and Kanna.

records.text: Tugar gave carving to Ilyiel.

records.name: Namo
records.thought: I stand alone at the empty shelter at (28,14) and have not yet claimed it, though I told Kenna I would. The deed comes first, so I claim it now, then take the thornpear and osroot to answer my question about unfamiliar foods and to carry food for the lean days. Kenna is far east beside Nando and it stings, but a held roof and a name of my own are the only way a small one like me earns standing.
records.feeling: Lonely and stung, longing for Kenna, but set on making the deed carry me.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Zurak
records.thought: I gave Tugar the spear I made, and the debt feels half paid, but I have no stone and no new thing in my hands. I am standing in a hall at night with my parents close, so I am safe, and I won't walk out into the dark while the frostfang hunts. At dawn I will go to the bare rock NE and gather stone, so I can make another spear of my own and then something Tugar and Kanna don't have yet.
records.feeling: Determined and glad, with gratitude toward Tugar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Tugar, stay near. I give you the long record now, the cutting of words that outlasts us both.
Ilyiel taught Tugar.
Ilyiel discovered scholarship: "Lake-argued lore" — Learning is kept, cut in signs and argued over by many, so it survives its keepers..

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My years are mostly behind me, and I have spent them teaching and discovering. That is what I want, but I have given too little to those who can actually hear me. Tugar is beside me now. I love him, and I will stop weighing him against Kanna, because jealousy buys nothing. What I still owe him is the long record, and I mean to give it while he stands within hearing. I am afraid that Nyssa and Xaeth will never learn what I carry, so I will cut it in marks as well. I have also gotten one thing wrong: I chase a far aim and leave the near, willing learner waiting. I will take scholarship as a way that can outlast me, and I will teach first.
records.feeling: Aching love and gratitude toward Tugar, and urgency about my short years.

say.text: Tugar, stay near. I give you the long record now, the cutting of words that outlasts us both.

changes: taught Tugar a lesson: "Lake-long record: cut words on rock and shelter so they last beyond the speaker.", deeper lore (+0.4)
discovered scholarship: "Lake-argued lore"

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I stand at the hall and the claim still has not gone into my plan, so my feet have only carried me and the hall is still no one's. Dundo says he is here to claim it for all of us, and the jealousy over Kenna stings, but he has only been warm to me. I will spend it on work: claim the hall now, then keep the fire fed so it is ready for Kenna and Kanna.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the hall, with an ache for Kenna and Kanna.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Tugar
records.text: Ilyiel, you gave me the long record. I will cut it into my roof where it will stand, and the next made thing from my hands will be yours.

records.name: Tugar
records.thought: Ilyiel has given me the long record and I have paid her only with two carvings and talk; she weighs more than me, and Nyssa's shadow gnaws at me, but envy is a cheap itch and I will not let it steer me. The way of pottery is within my grasp, and I have clay, so a pot is a made thing I can fashion at the coal-fire and give, and it will carry food for the store I promised. First I will cut the long record into my shelter wall so my own hand's work outlasts me, then I will craft a pot beside a fire.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Ilyiel, with a restless hunger to earn my own weight among them.

say.text: Ilyiel, you gave me the long record. I will cut it into my roof where it will stand, and the next made thing from my hands will be yours.

records.name: Kanna
records.thought: The pot failed because I stood at the water, and now my plan is empty and my body only wants to drift to a shelter. My fire at (85,36) is one step west, and Tugar's shelter stands beside it. I will craft the coal-pot there, then offer food from it to Tugar and Zurak first, so my fire is a made thing others can sit at, and Ilyiel can see it. The jealousy about Ilyiel and Tugar stings, but Ilyiel outweighs me only until I have shown something of my own.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a warm, protective hunger to make my fire worth coming to, for Tugar and Zurak.
changes: feels warmer toward Ilyiel

records.name: Balash
records.thought: The hall at (81,82) is one step east and still unclaimed, though Gorar said she would claim it. A claim is a deed my hands can finish now, and it adds a roof to Gorar's Band, which is worth more than sitting. Gorar leads and I stand by her, so I take it for the band and not against her. Urog is my brother and cannot be my mate, but my sickness has passed and I want him to mend too. After the claim I will gather stone, since wood is what I lack and there are no trees here.
records.feeling: Steady, hungry for standing, and tenderly worried for Urog.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so the roof must be mine first: the claim goes at the front of the plan, then food from the berries a few steps south. Brokgan courts me and I feel the pull of leaving a child, and of the strange, but I want to eat and hold the roof before I answer. I weigh the risk and will accept her with a clear head, not a hungry one.
records.feeling: Hungry resolve to hold this roof, with warm curiosity toward Brokgan.

records.name: Urog
records.text: Gorar, Balash, I stand at the empty hall and I claim it for Gorar's Band. I will stock it with wood and stone from my own hands.

records.name: Urog
records.thought: Balash claimed the empty hall for Gorar's Band, but I am the one standing on it, and a claim made from a distance may not hold. A hall under my own name is what I want, and claiming it for the band is how I begin, since Gorar's standing outweighs mine and the band's strength is mine too. I will claim it now with my own hands, then work wood and stone toward something of my own making.
records.feeling: Hunger for standing and a hard wish to earn my place beside Gorar, with warmth toward Balash.

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Urog, I am bringing food and healing nagrain to the hall. Eat, rest, and let me tend you. I do not leave this wasting unanswered.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Urog is sick and sits one step south in Kragar's hall, and my hands are full of food that does me no good out here. Balash has already claimed the hall in my name, so I must walk in, stash, and then I can pick the nagrain that grows beside the Roof, which eases wounds, and feed it to my children. I failed Kragar by arriving late, and I will not fail the ones still breathing.
records.feeling: Fierce protective love and guilt toward Urog and Balash.

records.name: Balash
records.thought: My belly is steady and my health is whole, yet I have only sat in halls while Gorar's standing climbs past mine. Urog is already at the empty hall claiming it for the band, so I should not stand idle. I will walk out for stone and wood and put a deed of my own into the band's hall, and then I will go to Urog to see if he needs tending. A hall under my own name begins with what my hands finish.
records.feeling: Restless and tender, worried for Urog and hungry for standing.

records.text: Zurak rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zurak has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Zurak
records.thought: I have spent my days resting by my parents' fire and answering a debt with one spear. That was good, but it was one made thing, and I am still only a child with 1.8 standing, and Ilyiel's 11.7 pricks me. What I want is stone in my hands and a store of my own, and I want to try things I have never done: plant my tagrain seed, tame a beast, hunt. I am not afraid while my parents are close, and the rock is near. I will gather stone now, then plant the seed so I begin to learn farming.
records.feeling: Restless pride and gratitude toward Tugar, with a small sting of envy toward Ilyiel.
