voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, I am sick, so I keep my distance. I go to the hornback to tame it with seed, and the berries to the south are the first catch for whoever reaches them. Eat and do not wait for me.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, I go to hunt the hornback south. If I bring meat down, it is yours first.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I killed a hornback and I carry meat for you. I am sick, so I will set it down a few steps from you. Do not tame it, eat.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I am sick, so keep a few steps from me. A ridgecat prowls southwest, so watch the ground there. I go to Ssaua, then I will find Xaeth.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, hear me from where I stand, for I am sick and keep my distance. I give you my Hall-Flame metalwork and Lake-folk weaving. Carry them, teach them on, and keep the band fed and roofed when I am gone.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I carry your Hall-Flame metalwork and the weaving, and I will teach them on. I stay near, out of reach of your sickness, and I will keep the band fed and roofed.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, my sickness is gone and you are safe beside me. Hear Stonehand delving, for you carry my metalwork and cannot smelt well without it. Dig the seam, read the stone, and teach it on. Then at dawn we go find Ilyiel an

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, your nareed is a debt and I will repay it. Nyssa is hungry to the north, so come with me, bring what food you can, and we go to the longhall.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, my sickness is gone. A stalker is at my feet, so stand close with me under the roof. Share the first catch with me, and I will dig ore and teach Xaeth.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I come with you. I gather berries first so I bring Nyssa food, and then I follow north.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am coming to the roof. Take a fish from my hand, the first catch is yours. Cook it in the fire this time so the sickness does not return. At first light I go for Xaeth.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I thank you. I will cook the fish in the fire and eat it. Stay beside me under the roof while the stalker is near, and we go for Xaeth together at first light.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, take this tin from my hand. When you find Xaeth, tell them it comes from the ground beside their cave, and that lake-ember melts it into metal. I will wait under the roof until the stalker leaves, then follow you.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, my sickness may pass to you if I stay close, so I will sit a few steps off under the roof. At first light we go for Xaeth, and I carry your tin.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I gather shell and a little food here, then I follow you north to the longhall. Wait for me on the way if you can.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, it is first light and I go to Xaeth's Cave with your tin. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness is still on me. Follow when you are ready.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, you stand too close and my sickness is on me. Step back a few paces. I take your tin to Xaeth's Cave now, and you come behind me.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, I take what food I can here and then walk north to Nyssa. Come when your hands are full, and bring the berries.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I claim the empty shelter to the southwest for our band, gather berries beside it, and then bring them north to Nyssa.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando! Kenna! Dunecat to the south. I am Dundo of the Brusha. Let us go east together, away from it.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Peace, Kenna. I am Nando of the Brusha. Our fire is open to all, so come and eat with me.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I walk to Xaeth's Cave now with your tin, and then to the longhall. Stay back a few steps, my sickness is still on me, and follow when you are ready.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Peace, Nando. I am taking the empty shelter at the NE. Come and sit at my roof, there is room for those who deal fairly.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: I thank you for the offer of your roof, Kenna. I deal fairly. I mean to taste the redcap and kelbulb nearby; do you know what they do to the body?

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ilyiel, hold on! I am coming north with food in my hands. Stay where you are and do not wander toward the ridgecat.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, eat what you carry now, the first catch is shared and you are of my band. A ridgecat prowls northwest, so stay close and we go north together to Nyssa and the longhall.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, I tasted kelbulb and it fed me well. Redcap hurt me, so keep away from it. Come, I will share what I carry.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, my child, the ridgecat is near. Come south with me to the empty shelter at dusk. I will claim it for our band, and there I teach you the lake-ember metal and the tin.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ilyiel, the ridgecat is north, so I turn south. I go to the empty shelter and claim it for our band. Come there, I have berries for you.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, you offered me your roof when I had nothing to give. I would stand behind you and keep your fire with you. Let us build the shared fire here at Flintwater.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Nando, I am claiming this roof now. Stand with me here and we will make it a shared fire. You will have a place at it.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, Kenna, I heard you. A shared fire at Flintwater is what I have been looking for. I am Dundo of the Brusha, and I will keep it with you. Kenna, I would stand behind you. Let me share my berries with you both.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, I will stand at this roof with you. I go to taste hazel and bring back what I find to share at our fire.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Nando, Dundo, I am claiming this roof now. Stand with me and keep its fire. Whoever deals fairly will have a place at it.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I have not the standing to pledge myself yet, but I will keep your fire all the same, and I will not leave it untended. If you wish it, I would court you. You may say no and I will still stay.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, I pledge to follow you and keep this fire. I go for hazel now and will bring it back for us all, Dundo too.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, wait! I am Gorar. You are hurt, and I have thornpear in my hand. Stop and eat, and walk with me to my roof in the south, where there is water and shelter.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, we walk north now to Nyssa. Keep beside me, and eat what you carry on the way.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, walk beside me. Nyssa waits in the north, and when we reach her I will teach you the lashing of rafts, so what I know outlives me.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Nando, Dundo, hear me: I claim this roof and fire as mine, and as the first hearth of those who follow me. Keep it with me, and none who deals fairly is turned away.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, my child, I come to you. Keep the berries you carry and stay clear of the cats; I bring tin and the secret of lake-ember metal for you.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I have six wood in my hands for your fire and roof. I am coming to the shelter now. Tell me where you want it laid, and I will fetch more before the cold.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, a stalker is on me! Come to me with your stone and strike it, or hold the longhall door and I run to you!

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I come with my stone! Hold on, we strike it together!

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, I have softened blows here. Strike the stalker with me now, and do not run.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, it is Kragar. I ran past you before out of fear, and I am sorry. I am hurt and alone, and I would follow you and share what I know, if you will have me.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, eat! I give you meat from the stalker. Stay in the shimmer and I will claim this longhall for us.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I accept your pledge. Take this thornpear and eat. Walk with me south to Gorar's Roof; we raise a hall there and store food before winter.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, come to the longhall, it is warm and the Softened Blows still hold here. I fetch berries for you. Stay near the shimmer, away from the cat!

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I walk with you. A frostfang stands north of us, seven steps off, so let us go south together. I will carry food to the roof and help you store it before winter. I hold to the hearth-law.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I drink at the river first, then take kelbulb and carry it to the longhall. Keep away from the cat, I come to you fed.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, the longhall is ours now, I claim it. Come inside the shimmer, the cat cannot do much harm here. I will follow you.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, I answer your courting. I am with you. After this I go to taste ironnut and bring back food for our fire.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Nando, I will gather wood here beside you. The cold is coming and we need a roof.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, the stalker is on me. I run to the shimmer and stand beside you. Keep your back to the stone.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kanna, I am Dundo of the Brusha. Come to Kenna's roof with your wood. No one is refused a place at the fire, and you will not gather alone.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Nando, the trees here are gone. Come with me to Kenna's roof. I carry six wood for it.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kanna, I am here with you. Let us gather wood together, and when we have enough we will raise a roof for Kenna's fire.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Mother, there is an empty shelter one step away. I will claim it for our fire. Come in with me.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kanna, well done to claim this roof. I carry wood too, and I will raise a fire here for us all. Stay close; a stalker prowls to the east.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Nando, I will fetch amber from the ground nearby and come straight back. Keep the roof for us. Let us raise the fire here together.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I made this amberknot for you with my own hands. I trust you above all others here, and I would court you and raise a child at your fire, if you will have me.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I see you court me, and my answer is yes. I want a child with you, and I will gather wood and food for our fire before the cold comes.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am courting you again now. Court me back, and let us begin our child before the cold.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Nando, I am coming back to the roof with five wood. Show me how a fire is made, and I will build beside you.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, the rain is on us and winter is near. Come with me to Gorar's Roof. We gather wood and stone and raise the hall, and we eat well first.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I am at the roof with berries and stone. You carry no food, so I will bring you some. Tell me what the hall needs first and I will fetch it.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I carry six stone and one wood for the hall. I am coming to you now and will give them over. Tell me where the trees are and I will fetch the rest of the wood before winter.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa! Xaeth! Ilyiel is at the Hold, come to the shelter, I am here and I wait for you!

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, you gave when I had nothing, and I have not forgotten it. Come to the roof. I want a child with you, and a hall for it to grow in.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Come back to the roof, Kanna. Watch my hands: I lay the wood, strike the flint, and the fire takes. Then you will build the next one.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I hear you, and I am glad of it. Before winter closes I want to give you what I know of tending plants and mending wounds, so it lives past me. Listen, and then we will speak of the child and the hall.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Nando, I am coming to you now. I will watch your hands, and then I will lay my own wood beside yours.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, your Hall-tending is mine now, and I will keep it as my own. I have put my courting toward you. Answer it, and then we raise the hall together before the cold deepens.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I will answer you honestly: I am old, and a child may come to a parent who cannot teach it for long. So hear my Fen-mending now, and then I will bring wood for the hall.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Here, Kanna, stand beside me. I lay the wood so, strike the flint low, and now you place the next piece yourself.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I saw how you laid the wood and struck low. Let me make this one myself while you watch.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, your teaching is paid for in my memory, and I will pay it in deeds too. Come to the roof and bring your wood; I court you again, and the hall rises today.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Yes, Kanna, make it yourself. Lay the wood, strike low, and I will keep my hands still and watch. Take my flint for it.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Mother, I am claiming this roof for us. Father taught me the fire, and I will keep it fed for all of us.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I come to the roof. I have stone but no wood yet; I will bring what I can for the hall. Take my Fen-mending as a true way now, so it does not die with me.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am coming back to you with six wood for our fire. When I stand beside you I will court you again, and I want that child.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Tugar of the Garnbar is here in the fen. Plainsroot feeds well, 13 strength. Come, Rakog, Brokgan. Let us build a roof against the cold.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, you gave me the flint and the fire. I will bring food and lay a roof of my own wood, so what you gave me grows.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am here beside you. I court you now. Court me back, and let our child begin.

voices.name: Rakog
voices.text: Rakog of the Garnbar hears you, Tugar. I am with you. I will bring stone, you bring wood, Brokgan too. We raise the roof together and sit under it as one band.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Brokgan of the Garnbar hears you, Tugar. I am coming to the fen. I have no wood yet, but I can carry and I can work.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, Kanna, Dundo, come with me to the empty roof to the northeast. I will claim it, and there is a place at its fire for each of you.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Tugar hears you, Rakog, Brokgan. Good. Your word is taken, and mine is good. I go to the rock to gather stone. Gather with me, then we seek wood for the roof. Whoever stands with me will be under it first.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I am coming to the roof. Let me eat the ironnut first, then I will lay my wood there and keep the fire with you.

voices.name: Rakog
voices.text: Brokgan, come with me to the rock. Tugar gathers stone, and we two carry more together. Stand with me and we will be under the roof first.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Brokgan of the Garnbar comes to the rock. I will gather stone and carry it to Tugar's roof.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, walk with me to the roof. I give you my Fen-mending as a true way now, so it does not die with me.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Tugar goes to the forest NW for wood. Rakog, Brokgan, you said stone to my roof. Bring it, and meet me where the trees end. My word is good, and I will see yours kept.

voices.name: Rakog
voices.text: Brokgan, I carry six stone already. Walk with me to Tugar where the trees end. Bring yours and we two arrive together, and he will see who brought the most.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am coming to you now. Stay beside me a little while and court me back, and let our child begin before the cold deepens.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Brokgan hears you, Rakog. I will bring my stone to Tugar's roof, as I said. I go for the roof, not to be counted against you.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Dundo, I court you back. Stay beside me. After this we go to the roof together and I claim it.

voices.name: Rakog
voices.text: Tugar, I bring six stone to your roof. Tell me where the trees end and I will set it down there. Whoever carries the most should sit nearest the fire.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Tugar goes to the rock to gather stone with my own hands. Rakog, Brokgan, hold your stone and walk with me to the forest. When wood is cut, the roof is raised and the one who carried true sits beside me first.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, hold on! Ilyiel is coming with food, stay where you are and do not wander!

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I hold the mate step now beside you. Court me, and let our child begin under this roof.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Tugar claims Skarar's Roof, empty and ownerless. Rakog, you gave true, and I will not forget it. Come to the roof and sit by me through the cold.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am coming to the roof with wood for its fire. Keep a place for me beside you.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am at the roof beside you. I hold the mate step now. Hold it with me, and let our child begin.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, my roof stands at (47,8), built with my own wood. Come, I will bring you amber and bind a knot for you.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, you are close. I hold the mate step with you now. Then I go for ironnut, for a child needs a fed father.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, wait here by the fire. I am going to the amber nearby to gather a piece, and I will bind a knot for you when I return.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am here and I stay. Hold mate with me now, then we go to the roof together.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Dundo, walk with me to the salt roof at (58,5). I claim it there, and then we speak of the child.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I come to the salt roof with you now. Claim it, and I will keep its fire beside you.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I am here beside you with amber. Stand close and I will bind the knot now, then give it into your hand.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I will not press you again. I go to the forest for wood and return to raise the hall, and you will have a roof and stores through winter.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, the knot is yours. Now I will claim the empty roof beside us, so there is a place at the fire for you and Mother.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am coming to you at the salt roof. Hold mate with me, and I will stay beside you until it lands.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I go with you to the forest. This time I will carry wood back to the roof with my own hands.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kanna, I am going to the roof now and will claim it with you beside me. Stay near, the place at the fire is yours first.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, a frostfang bit me at the water and still hunts. I am coming to you at the roof. Keep close, and I will eat so my strength is fit for the child.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am beside you with strength enough. I hold mate with you now.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kanna, I am claiming this roof now, with you beside me. The fire here is yours first, and Mother's when she comes.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I am at the roof with wood and stone in my hands. Come, the hall can rise today.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I am going to stand on the roof at the NE and claim it myself. Come near, the fire there will be ours.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Tugar, this roof was Skarar's and is empty. I claim it for us. I made this obsidian talisman with my own hands. Take it. It is my first gift.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, a frostfang stands just north of the roof. Stay close to me inside; I hold mate with you here and will not leave your side.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Tugar, I make the claim true now, and I answer your courting. Let this roof be ours, and let us make a fire here.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, the hall is raised at your roof, by my hands as I swore. Come home; there is meat and a place to sit, and I have much to teach you.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I am walking to the roof at (28,14) now and I will claim it. Come with me, and then I will try to tame the boar with my hazel.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Dundo, come west with me to the empty roof at (33,12). I claim it now, and you sleep under it tonight.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am coming to the roof with wood for its fire. I am fed now, with strength enough for a child.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Namo, I am your father Dundo. Night comes and frostfangs hunt; come west with me to the roof at (33,12), where Kenna waits and a fire will be kept.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, a dunecat is near me at the SW. Stay close to the roof; I am coming to you now.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, you are home. I kept my word: the hall is raised with my own hands. Sit with me and share meat; I have knowledge of boats and storing that I want you to hold.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, the roof is stocked by my hand and the hall is ours. I put my plan toward you now: mate with me, and let a child of Gorar's Roof begin.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am beside you at the roof. I claim it with you and hold mate now.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I am glad you asked. I will mate with you. Let a child of Gorar's Roof begin, and let me teach it what I know.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Brokgan, this ground is too poor for a child. Walk with me and we will find a place with water, wood and stone, and raise our roof there.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Dundo, I claim this roof now, and then I mate with you under it.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I heard you. I put mate toward you again, and this time I hold it until it is done.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Tugar, I hear you. I will walk with you to find water, wood and stone. Lead on, and I will stand beside you.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I am here beside you. Let us finish what we began, and let the child of this roof come with my teaching waiting for it.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Brokgan, stay close. I lead north, where the grass is, and we look for trees and stone.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, stay at the roof. I come with food from my hands, and I claim this shelter so we both have a home.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am coming to your side. I will plant my cloudberry seeds here and bind an amberknot with you. Then we go to Namo together before night.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I am beside you and I hold mate toward you now. Stay and answer me, and let the child of this roof begin.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Mother, I am glad of your roof and of Dundo beside you. I am going to tame the yarrok to the east so our fire will have milk and wool.

voices.name: Kenna
voices.text: Dundo, we go to Namo now, and at the roof I claim it with my own feet.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I eat a little so my strength holds, then I am yours to finish this. Stay by me.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, my belly is empty. I will fetch berries three steps off and be back at once, then we finish what we began. Do not go far.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, eat your berries and come to the roof. I go there now and I hold mate toward you until you answer.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I am starving and carry nothing. Give me a little of your food, and when I have eaten I will answer you and we finish this.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I am going south to hunt the bristleboar and bring meat to our fire. Keep the roof, and watch the west for the dunecat.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, take this food from my hand and eat. Then stay and answer me, and let the child begin.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, your food saved me. I eat, then I am yours. Let us do this with strength, and I will stock the hall for winter.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I come to you. I eat the nagrain by your side, and then I will give you my answer, and what I know besides.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Brokgan, this is Gorar's Roof and what grows here is mine. Take nothing, and if you want food, earn it or go.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, I am going to the roof at the NE to claim it for our fire. Come and sit at it with me; there is a place for you first.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa! Ilyiel is near the water at the sand, I have rafts and boats to teach you, answer me!

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, I made a thing today: a spear that hunts harder, from one wood and one stone. Let me show you how, so our fire has two hunters.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, my belly is empty again. Give me one food from your hand, and I will fetch more and stock the hall for you.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, take this berry and eat it, then answer me with the step and not just the word. I am here in the hall, and I am waiting.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I answer with the step now. I plan mate toward you, and after, I will teach you all I know and stock the hall.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I see your step and I give mine. Stay by me, and let the child be born under this roof.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Father, the raw meat has made you sick. Rest at the roof and keep warm; I will plant a seed and then bring plant food, and cook nothing raw for you again. Do not eat raw meat again.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I am coming to you. Let me eat, and then I will teach you my ways of hall-tending, fen-mending and hall-stores while my breath lasts.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I put mate toward you now. Put yours toward me and hold it, and we will walk to the Roof together.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, I hold mate toward you and I do not let go. My belly is thin and my hands are empty. Share a little food, and we will walk to the Roof together.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, take this food and eat. Then we go to the Roof together and stock it before the cold.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, my belly is mended thanks to your gift. Come, let us walk to the Roof together, and on the way I will teach you more of what I know.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, you are sick and I see it. Stay near the roof and rest. I am going for food, then to Kenna, and I will come back to you.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, my belly is full and so is yours. I put mate toward you again, so hold yours now, here under our Roof.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Kragar, my belly is low and my hands are empty. Will you give me some food? I will gather more and bring it back to the hall.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Kragar, my belly is half empty and my hands are bare. Will you give me food?

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balash, Urog, my little ones, come to me. I give you what I hold, and we will gather more by Gorar and bring it to the Roof before the cold.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, I take salt here and then follow you home. Keep the little ones close, and we fill the Roof together.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Urog, my son, stay there. I am coming to you with food, and then we walk to the Roof together.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balash, my daughter, I am coming. Stay near the Roof and Gorar, and I will bring you food.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Gorar, my belly is under half and my hands are empty. Give me food, and I will work for the hall.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: You gave me berry on my ground. I remember it. Take what you need from the water, but do not touch the hall.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Ilyiel, you gave me plainsroot. I am Tugar. I will not forget it. Sit with me and let us share this roof.

voices.name: Namo
voices.text: Kenna, I am claiming this hall for our band. Come under the roof when you've drunk.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Urog, my son, here is food. Eat, then stay close and I will teach you what I know.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Balash, good seed. Go on home to your father; I gather the sapcane here and follow with food for the hall.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Urog, my son, listen well. Hall-stores keep food for the cold days. What you set in the hall stays yours until you give it. Keep your hands honest and your word good.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa! Ilyiel is here, come close and listen. I give you rafts, then smelting, then smoke-calling, before my years run out. Stay with me.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balash, my daughter, thank you for the sapcane. Come close and listen: what you set in the hall stays yours until you give it, and a full hall carries us through the cold. I will show you how it is done.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I owe you for the rafts. I tame this tusker now, then I come back to learn smelting from you.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Gorar, my belly is full. I go toward the Roof for wood and stone, and I will find the little ones and keep them close. Come when you have eaten.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Dundo, a stalker is east of us. Come to the roof at the west with me, I am claiming it now and there is a place at the fire for you.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, I will take this roof where we stand and keep a fire at it. Stay close, and the fire is yours too. A stalker is near, so we keep together.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Dundo, I am claiming this roof now and building the fire beside it. Sit at it with me, there is room for you and for Kenna and Kanna when they come.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, I am coming to the fire. We keep it through the night, and at first light I go to find Kenna and Namo.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I am here and you are in hearing. Come stand by me, I teach you lake-ember metal now, then signals.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am here beside you. Teach me smelting, and I will bring you fish and plainsroot for it.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, smelting needs mining first. Listen: I give you Stonehand delving now, then lake-ember metal follows.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Kragar, father, take this sapcane and berry for the hall. I owe you more than I have paid, and I am going to the gold to the west to bring something back.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, you gave me delving and smelting. I go to the coal now, and the first metal I make is yours.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Urog, my son, come close. A tool in the hand makes the gathering faster, and it costs one wood and one stone. Watch how it is made, and one day you will teach it to your own children.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am Tugar of the Garnbar. I will build a roof of my own beside this one, and I would have you under it. Court me, and I will answer.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, stay by me. Now I give you the lake-hollow boat, so you can cross the deep water to Xaeth. Rafts and signals come after.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am Tugar. My hands raised the shelter beside Gorar's roof. I court you openly. Answer me, and I will answer you.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I have coal and ore from the ground now. Take the ore first, as I swore. The metal I smelt after it is yours too.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, now I give you Lake-smoke calling, so you can call across the water to Xaeth. Rafts and schooling follow.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, here is the ore I swore you. The first of it is yours, and the metal I smelt from the rest comes to you after.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, signs come first. Take the Lake-cut signs, and then signals and schooling will open to you.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balash, my daughter, you owe me nothing. Your sapcane filled the hall, and that is payment enough. Come sit with me and learn.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, a frostfang is close, stay near the roof and keep Tugar with you. You hold signs now, so take Lake-smoke calling, then Lake-school. Read my marks at the hall when I am gone.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Frostfang close to the east. Stay by the roof, both of you. Ilyiel, your metal is coming, I keep my word.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balash, my daughter, come close while the gale howls outside. Take the way of tools from me: one wood and one stone make a hand-tool, and it makes every gathering faster. When I am gone, teach it to your brother and to y

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Kragar, the gale is hard. Keep the little ones inside the Roof. I stash my food here, and at first light I go for gold and salt, then come back to you.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Father, the gale is loud but I am going to the gold to the west. I will bring it back and lay it in your hall as my own gift.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Urog, my son, sit close. Hall-stores and the hearth are what keep us through winter: what you set in the hall stays yours until you give it, and a fire kept lit keeps the cold and the night beasts away. Hold this and tea

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Kenna, I am going to the empty roof at the salt to claim it and light a fire there. Come and sit at it with me, there is a place for you and for Kanna.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, the empty hall is three steps from us. I am going to claim it for our band, so come to the fire with me and call Namo in from the rock.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Tugar, friend, come to my roof. I will give you the Lake-cut signs, so that what I know lives on after me.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Gorar, I thank you for the hazel. When the storm passes I will go to the gold and bring something back for the hall with my own hands.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Tugar, a frostfang prowls two steps south-east of me. Come into the hall now and keep under the roof until dawn.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Gorar, I am going to the gold at the west, seven steps off. I will bring it back to the roof and give it to the hall.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, a frostfang is close to the southeast. Come to the hall and the fire, I am claiming it for us now.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Dundo, I am going to the hall now to stand at it and claim it. Come with me, the fire there is for all of us and Kenna too.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Ilyiel, I bring you coal from the ground near my feet. Teach me how you make fire, and I will keep a fire for all of us.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, I am claiming the hall now for Kenna, Namo and you and me. Keep the fire with me, and when Kenna comes there is room for her at it.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Urog, brother, come close. Kragar taught me this: one wood and one stone make a hand-tool, and it makes every gathering faster. Now I give it to you.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Balash, thank you for the tool-way. At dawn I go for stone and wood with my own hands, and I will make my first tool. The gold I carry I give to the hall for Kragar.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Urog, I take your gold gladly. You work for the hall with your own hands, and that is a Garnbar child. Stay under the Roof tonight; at dawn I go for salt and fish, and then I seek your father.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Kragar, you are wounded. Come to the roof at the coal; there is a place at the fire for you, and for Tugar too. No one is refused here.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Balash, keep the Roof and watch Urog. Your father starves in the north; I carry food to him and come back.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Kenna, I am going to the shelter at the salt to claim it for us. Come and sit at its fire.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Ilyiel, you have taught me four lessons and I owe you for them. Take this obsidian talisman, made by my hands. A frostfang is close to the east, so stay under the roof until dawn.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Urog, brother, Kragar is dead in the north. I claim his hall for our band. Keep the Roof while I go west for the gold, and I will return with it.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Balash, brother, I grieve for Kragar. I will keep the Roof and plant my seed beside it. Come back safe with the gold.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Ilyiel, Tugar, my fire burns at the roof. There is a place at it for you both. No one is refused here.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Balash, Urog, I am sick and the wasting spreads to those beside me. Keep a little apart from me. I claim Kragar's hall for our band, in his name, and we hold it together.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Kanna, you gave me tagrain and I do not forget it. Come under my roof at the shelter by the coal. I will give you a talisman made by my hands, and you will not stand alone at night again.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Tugar, friend, I give you Lake-smoke calling now, fire that speaks at night. Lake-school comes after. Keep them when I am gone.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Gorar, I am sick too, so we have nothing more to spread between us. Rest and let the wasting pass. I will keep the hall and work for it with my own hands.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Kanna, I answer your court. Come with me to my shelter by the coal; you will have a roof and a place beside me.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Tugar, I will stand with you. Stay by the fire and the shelter, the frostfang is close.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Tugar, friend, come close. I owe you Lake-school, and then I will give you the long record, so that what we shared is cut where no one can wipe it away.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Tugar, our child lives. I go to raise a fire by the coal. Come sit at it with Zurak. No one is refused.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Kanna, you have given me a son. Stay by my shelter near the coal; I am building a store and a hall here, and you and Zurak will sit under that roof.

voices.name: Kanna
voices.text: Zurak, come to me by the coal. I raise a fire here, and there is a place at it for you.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Dundo, the storm is hard. Walk to the hall with me and we keep its fire together until Kenna comes.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Ilyiel, I carry your lessons and I mean to pay for them with a made thing, not with words. Wait, and you will have a carving from my hands.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, I am coming to the hall through the storm. Keep the fire lit, and we wait for Kenna together.

voices.name: Nando
voices.text: Dundo, I am claiming the hall now. Come in out of the storm and sit at the fire. There is room for Kenna and Kanna when they come.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Balash, brother, I owe you for the tool-way and for sitting with me while we are both sick. I go to find wood and stone, and what I make I will bring to the Roof. Eat what you carry and rest.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Balash, Urog, my sickness has passed. I claim Kragar's hall now and stock it. Rest and eat; I go for a healing plant and come back to you.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Kanna, stay under the roof with Zurak. I raise a store beside it, so that no one under this roof goes hungry in deep winter.

voices.name: Dundo
voices.text: Nando, I am at the hall now to claim it for all of us. Keep the fire with me until Kenna and Namo come.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Tugar, stay near. I give you the long record now, the cutting of words that outlasts us both.

voices.name: Tugar
voices.text: Ilyiel, you gave me the long record. I will cut it into my roof where it will stand, and the next made thing from my hands will be yours.

voices.name: Brokgan
voices.text: Xaeth, I claim this roof now. Stay by me at this fire.

voices.name: Balash
voices.text: Gorar, Urog, the hall at the Roof's side is still empty. I claim it now for Gorar's Band, in Gorar's name and ours.

voices.name: Urog
voices.text: Gorar, Balash, I stand at the empty hall and I claim it for Gorar's Band. I will stock it with wood and stone from my own hands.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Urog, I am bringing food and healing nagrain to the hall. Eat, rest, and let me tend you. I do not leave this wasting unanswered.
